Mali.title: Mali: Goïta receives three foreign delegations regarding military cooperation
Mali.summary: On Wednesday, 11 November 2026, in Bamako, the President of Mali's Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, received official delegations from Türkiye, Chad and Uganda, who had come to attend the International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX 2026) for discussions focused on military partnerships and African security challenges. . The three meetings took place at the Koulouba Palace on the third day of the trade fair, which brings together military officials, institutional representatives and defence industry professionals in the Malian capital.

Mali.title: FAMa: three airstrikes against...
Mali.summary: FAMa: Three airstrikes against terrorist positions in Kidal, Timbuktu and Sikasso The General Staff of the Armed Forces announces new military operations as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out several precision strikes on 10 and 11 November 2026 against identified targets in the Kidal, Timbuktu and Sikasso regions.

Mali.title: Mali-Türkiye cooperation: Towards a strengthened security partnership
Mali.summary: Cooperation between Mali and Türkiye: a strategic partnership to strengthen security On Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly MOHAMMEDINE, received an important Turkish delegation led by the Deputy Minister of National Defence of the Republic of Türkiye, His Excellency Mr Bilal DURDALI. . This meeting, held on the sidelines of the International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX 26), is part of the strengthening of cooperative relations between Mali and Türkiye, particularly in the field of security.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Fight against drugs: EMP-ABB auditors spend time at the Central Office for Narcotics
Mali.summary: Bamako, 11 November (AMAP) – On Wednesday, the Central Office for Narcotics (OCS) welcomed the 4th cohort of the Master's in Peacekeeping and State Reconstruction from the Alioune Blondin Bèye Peacekeeping School (EMP-ABB), as part of a professional immersion visit focused on the operational realities of combating illicit drug trafficking and organised crime, AMAP reported.

Mali.title: People deported from Guinea: returns are being organised, the human toll remains to be determined
Mali.summary: RIGHT NOW Between the border post, the reception sites and the departure points, operations are entering a new phase. The Malian and Burkinabé authorities are now organising convoys from several assembly points in order to reduce the long internal journeys imposed on people leaving the gold mining areas of Guinea. .

Mali.title: Security: 75 pick-up trucks and 25 motorcycles handed over to the Police and the Gendarmerie
Mali.summary: On Friday, 6 November 2020, the Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, handed over a batch of vehicles to the National Police and the National Gendarmerie. . Funded by the national budget, this allocation includes 75 Toyota pick-up trucks for the Police's rapid response units, as well as 25 high-capacity motorcycles for the presidential escorts provided by the Gendarmerie.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike terrorist positions in Tinzaouatène, Tonka, and near Sikasso
Mali.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa strike terrorist positions in Tinzaouatène, Tonka and near Sikasso The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their operations to secure the territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Several strikes carried out over the past two days have been reviewed by the General Staff of the Armed Forces.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The Malian Army neutralises several terrorist targets in Tinzaouatène, Tonka and Sikasso
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, approximately twenty-seven (27) kilometres north-west of Tinzaouatène, in the Kidal region, a previously identified terrorist target was struck three (03) times.

Mali.title: MALIAN ARMED FORCES: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces inaugurates new facilities at Camp Sénou
Mali.summary: As part of the implementation of the strategic vision of the High Military Command, which focuses on strengthening the logistical capabilities of military bases and improving the well-being of personnel, the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Élisée Jean DAO, inaugurated a modern bakery and a soldiers' recreation centre at Camp Dassiri in Sénou on Monday, 9 November 2026.

Mali.title: BAMEX'26: A strengthened diplomatic and strategic axis at Koulouba At the Koulouba Palace, the Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, received delegations from Türkiye, Chad and Uganda on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. These high-level meetings, held on the sidelines of the Bamako International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX'26), embody a shared ambition: to embed military cooperation within a dynamic of continental sovereignty and integration.
Mali.summary: By opening the doors of the Presidency to these strategic delegations, the Head of State is giving substance to the scope of BAMEX'26, making security expertise a major diplomatic lever. Discussions held with Bilal Durdali, Deputy Minister of National Defence of Türkiye, General Issakha Malloua Djamous, Chadian Minister of the Armed Forces, and the Honourable Dr Hajjat Oleru Huda Abason, Ugandan Minister of State for Defence, provided an opportunity to address regional security challenges and the strengthening of technical partnerships.

Mali.title: Mali: The Malian army executes and mutilates five people in the Cercle of Kati, near Bamako
Mali.summary: Mali: The Malian army executes and mutilates five people in the Kati Cercle, near Bamako Five people were executed by the Malian army in the village of Daba, in the commune of Faladié, Kati Cercle, a few dozen kilometres from Bamako. The events, which took place on Thursday, 5 November, were revealed by the Fulani community association Jeunesse Pulaaku Internationale, which also reports genital mutilation.

Mali.title: Mali: AFRICOM chief received by Assimi Goïta in Bamako, despite the security alliance with Moscow
Mali.summary: On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, AFRICOM Commander General Dagvin Anderson met with Mali's Transitional President, Assimi Goïta, in Bamako, on the sidelines of the BAMEX defence exhibition. This meeting took place at a time when Bamako is relying on Moscow for its security AFRICOM's official X account described it as follows: "AFRICOM Commander General Dagvin Anderson attended BAMEX and met with Malian President Assimi Goïta in Bamako to discuss options for countering common threats, particularly JNIM and ISGS".

Mali.title: Burkina Faso bans filming of returnees from Guinea during distribution of donations
Mali.summary: On 10 November 2026, the Ministry of Family and Solidarity issued a statement welcoming a "wave of solidarity" towards Burkinabès forced to leave Guinea. While encouraging this mobilisation, it asks the initiators of these actions to ensure that the "dignity" of the beneficiaries is respected. As a reminder, since the end of October, Guinea has been carrying out operations against illegal gold panning following the suspension of artisanal gold mining.

Mali.title: Security cooperation: The Transitional President grants an audience to the Commander of AFRICOM
Mali.summary: BAMEX 2026: The Transitional President receives the Commander of AFRICOM. On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, the Transitional President and Head of State, His Excellency General Assimi Goïta, granted an audience to General Dagvin R. M.

Mali.title: Military and security cooperation: General Assimi Goïta receives an Iranian delegation on the sidelines of BAMEX 2026
Mali.summary: On the sidelines of the Bamako International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX), which is being held from 9 to 13 November 2026, the Transitional President, His Excellency Army General Assimi Goïta, Head of State, granted an audience on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, to an Iranian delegation led by Mr Abass Mohammadi, Deputy Minister for Industrial Affairs and Research at the Iranian Ministry of Defence.

Mali.title: Murder of pharmacist Abdourhamane Kodio: the death penalty sought against the three defendants
Mali.summary: Murder of pharmacist Abdourhamane Kodio: the death penalty sought against the three accused The trial of the three men accused of the murder of Dr Abdourhamane Kodio opened on Tuesday, 10 November 2026 before the Assize Court of Bamako. The pharmacist was shot dead during a robbery at his pharmacy in Kalaban-Coura ACI. .

Mali.title: BAMEX 2026: Bamako, the unmissable event for security and innovation
Mali.summary: On 9 November 2026, at the Bamako Exhibition Centre, the Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, inaugurated the 2nd edition of BAMEX (International Defence and Security Exhibition), which is being held from 9 to 13 November. The event brought together a distinguished gathering of individuals, including diplomats, government officials, and military and civilian representatives.

Mali.title: Burkina Faso bans filming of returnees from Guinea during distribution of donations
Mali.summary: On 10 November 2026, the Ministry of Family and Solidarity issued a statement welcoming a 'wave of solidarity' towards Burkinabès forced to leave Guinea. While encouraging this mobilisation, it asks the initiators of these actions to ensure that the "dignity" of the beneficiaries is respected. .

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Cooperation: The Commander of US Africa Command welcomed at Koulouba
Mali.summary: Bamako, 11 November (AMAP) The Commander of United States military operations in Africa, General Dagvin Anderson, was received on Tuesday by the Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, in Koulouba, AMAP observed. The U.S. general officer is visiting our country as part of the International Defence and Security Exhibition (Bamex), which has been underway since last Monday.

Mali.title: Mali–United States: Goïta and the head of AFRICOM discuss counter-terrorism
Mali.summary: On Tuesday, 10 November 2020, Mali's Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, received the Commander of United States Africa Command (AFRICOM), General Dagvin Anderson, in Bamako for discussions on the terrorist threat in the Sahel and the prospects for security cooperation between the two countries. . The meeting took place at the Koulouba Palace, on the sidelines of the International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX 2026), which opened on Monday in the Malian capital and in which the US military official is taking part.

Burkina Faso.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Burkina Faso.title: AES Confederation: Ministers meet in Ouagadougou to assess the Year II roadmap
Burkina Faso.summary: Bamako, 11 November (AMAP) The ministers of the member states of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES) are meeting on Wednesday and Thursday in Ouagadougou to assess the implementation of the Year II roadmap and to formulate recommendations in preparation for the next session of the College of Heads of State. The discussions will focus on the three pillars of the Confederation: Defence and Security, Diplomacy and Development.

Burkina Faso.title: Recruitment of forty (40) security guards
Burkina Faso.summary: Recruitment of forty (40) security officers leFaso.net – News from Burkina Faso

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Armed Group Kills Civilians
Burkina Faso.summary: An Al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Burkina Faso’s northern Yatenga province in September 2026. The group’s relentless, unlawful attacks put civilians across Burkina Faso at grave risk. The laws of war prohibit attacking civilians, and those who order, commit, or assist serious violations of the laws of war with criminal intent may be prosecuted for war crimes.

Niger.title: DSS Intercepts Arms Shipment From Niger Republic In Sokoto, Arrests Female Courier
Niger.summary: The Department of State Services (DSS) has intercepted a large consignment of weapons and ammunition smuggled into Nigeria from the Niger Republic, a security source has disclosed. The weapons, comprising 21 AK-47 rifles, four PKT machine guns and 825 magazines, were intercepted by DSS operatives in Dawakawa, Goronyo Local Government Area of Sokoto State, following surveillance of suspected terrorist networks.

Niger.title: Niger: Following protests in Niamey and Algiers, the EU spokesperson clarifies the EU’s position
Niger.summary: At a press briefing held on Tuesday, the European Union (EU) spokesperson, Anouar El-Anouni, revisited his comments on military cooperation between Niger and Algeria, stressing that “the European Union fully respects the sovereignty of both nations and has no intention of interfering”. He also clarified that "Algeria's decision to deploy troops to Niger is a matter for the bilateral relationship between Algeria and Niger" and that the EU had "at no time intended to ask either of these two partners for clarifications on their bilateral engagement".

Niger.title: Algerian parliament rejects EU remarks on military deployment to Niger
Niger.summary: A military parade to celebrate the 60th anniversary of Algeria’s independence, in its capital, Algiers, July 5, 2022. /VCG Algeria's Council of the Nation on Tuesday strongly rejected European Union (EU) remarks over Algeria's decision to deploy units of the People's National Army (ANP) to Niger at the Sahel country's request. In a statement, the council denounced what it described as an "arrogant and immature" intervention from abroad, accusing unnamed parties of attempting to interfere in the internal affairs of two sovereign countries and use the issue to serve their own political agendas.

Niger.title: Niger: Nearly 64,000 Flee Nigeria for Niger Where a Humanitarian Crisis Is Deepening
Niger.summary: Violence in northern Nigeria is fueling a growing humanitarian crisis across the whole region: 64,000 have fled to neighbouring Niger and several hundred have left for Benin since the start of the year, as host countries struggle to cope, the UN's refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Tuesday. Northern Nigeria has been experiencing multiple, overlapping security crises involving jihadist insurgencies, armed banditry, and farmer-herder conflicts, forcing millions from their homes over the past 25 years.

Niger.title: Algeria-Niger. What's gotten into the EU spokesperson?
Niger.summary: The statement in Brussels by a European Union spokesperson, who appeared to be speaking on his own initiative, provoked the anger of Algeria and Niger, who were outraged at being questioned about their military cooperation. The incident highlights the difficulty the European Commission has in extricating itself from French pressure and manoeuvring in the Sahel.

On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, approximately twenty-seven (27) kilometres north-west of Tinzaouatène, in the Kidal region, a previously identified terrorist target was struck three (03) times.

significant_events.title: Gao-N 'tahaka axis: the FAMa neutralize armed men who racketeered travelers
significant_events.summary: Gao-N 'tahaka axis: the FAMa neutralize armed men who racketeered travellers The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) put an end to the actions of armed men who set up illegal roadblocks on the Gao-N'tahaka axis to extort money from travellers. This operation should make it possible to strengthen security on this strategic route, heavily used by carriers and the populations of the region .

Mali.title: Douentza and Koro: the return of displaced people facing significant challenges
Mali.summary: After several years of displacement, the inhabitants of Drimbé, in the Douentza circle, are starting preparations for their return. They are mobilizing to clear their village, abandoned for nearly eight years. In the Koro circle, several localities have already welcomed some of their inhabitants.

Mali.title: Africa Corps Leads Deadly Drone Campaign in Mali
Mali.summary: Images out of northern Mali show attacks by or wreckage from Russian-operated drones targeting Tuareg separatists, terrorists and civilians alike. Experts say the images are evidence that Russia’s Africa Corps mercenaries have taken control of the ruling junta’s air campaign and may be committing war crimes. According to the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED) project, Africa Corps and the Malian junta killed 89 civilians in 49 airstrikes between April and August, more than double the number from the same period the year before.

Mali.source: OCHA Afrique de l'Ouest et du Centre
Mali.title: Mali: Displaced families in Sarema seek safety and a way forward
Mali.summary: By Seynabou Niang Families displaced by violence in central Mali are starting over in Sarema, located 640 kilometers north-east of the capital Bamako, in the Mopti Region. While some arrived just a few months ago, others have been here since late 2024. A new place to call home In Mali's Bandiagara Region, Soumaila Djiguiba used to earn a living trading livestock in Kori-Kori.

Mali.title: Mali: Fama bomb terrorist groups in Menaka and Kidal
Mali.summary: In a statement issued yesterday Sunday, November 8, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Mali informs that the country's Armed Forces, supported by their partners, bombed several terrorist groups on Friday, November 06 and Saturday, November 07, 2026 in Menaka and Kidal "On Friday, November 6, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence, made it possible to locate about 50 kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka, a terrorist group with war materials.

Burkina Faso.title: Support for SDS orphans: The Pananetugri Initiative provides school kits to orphans
Burkina Faso.summary: The Pananetugri Initiative for the Well-being of Women (IPBF) has handed over 215 school kits to the Directorate of Social Action and Psychological Services of the National Gendarmerie (DASSP-GN) of Burkina Faso for the benefit of the children of fallen soldiers. It was Friday, October 9, 2026 . On the occasion of the start of the 2026-2027 school year, the Pananetugri Initiative for the Well-being of Women (IPBF) is making its heart speak for the children of fallen soldiers.

Niger.title: Niger-Algeria: EU clarifies its position after protests in Niamey and Algiers
Niger.summary: The European Union (EU) assured on Tuesday that it had never asked Niger or Algeria for explanations on their military cooperation, returning to the controversy aroused by the statements of its spokesperson concerning the deployment of Algerian troops in Nigerian territory “The Algerian decision to deploy troops in Niger is part of the bilateral relationship between Algeria and Niger,” Anouar El Anouni, EU foreign affairs spokesman, told the European Commission's press briefing in Brussels.

Niger.title: MOSOP accuses Niger Delta governors of mismanaging 13% derivation funds
Niger.summary: ….Group calls for amendment of derivation law, commends NDDC’s development efforts By Daniel Abia PORT HARCOURT — The Movement for the Survival of the Ogoni People (MOSOP) has accused successive governors in the Niger Delta of mismanaging the 13 per cent derivation funds, calling for an amendment of the law to ensure that oil-producing communities directly benefit from the revenue.

Niger.title: Niger-EU: Niamey raises its voice after statements on the Algerian military deployment
Niger.summary: The reception of the European Chargé d 'affaires by the Nigerien Prime Minister on 9 November illustrates the tensions aroused by Brussels' requests for explanations on the deployment of Algerian soldiers in Niger, an initiative that Niamey considers to be fully within its sovereignty . The Prime Minister of Niger, Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine, received Monday, November 9, 2026 the Chargé d 'affaires of the European Union (EU) in Niamey, following statements by the spokesperson of the European Commission on the deployment of Algerian military units in Niger .

Niger.title: Shangarha explains the nature of the mission of the Algerian army in Niger… and the President of the African Parliament responds to the statements of the spokesman of the European Union
Niger.summary: Algeria - “Al-Quds Al-Arabi”: The speech of the Chief of Staff of the Algerian Army, General Said Shangarha, shed more light on the nature of the military mission in Niger, at a time when responses are continuing to the statements of the spokesman of the European Union, which called on Algeria to provide clarifications after the adoption of the resolution Shangarha said that sending a military formation to northern Niger falls within the framework of protecting joint energy installations and projects between the two countries, in response to the request of the Nigerian authorities, and within the approach of…

Niger.title: A European request that angered Algeria about the deployment of its army in Niger
Niger.summary: The EU's request for clarifications on sending Algerian military units to Niger has sparked controversy and drawn widespread criticism in Algerian media and political circles. The European Union Spokesman for Foreign Affairs, Policy and Security Affairs expressed the Union's concern and follow-up to the Algerian military move and the deployment of army units in Nigerian territory The European Union is awaiting clarifications from Algeria on the deployment of units of the Algerian army in Niger, the extent, objective and basis of this deployment, the European official said in press statements.

Niger.title: Niger: Floods - Sep 2026
Niger.summary: Disaster description As of 1 September, floods have affected 34,372 people (5,470 households), causing 44 deaths and 95 injuries. Maradi, Zinder and Dosso are the worst affected, with 4,412 houses collapsed, 43 classrooms damaged, livestock losses and destroyed food stocks. Priorities include household assistance, emergency shelter, protection of displaced people and restoration of essential services.

Mali.title: Gao-N 'tahaka axis: the FAMa neutralize armed men who racketeered travelers
Mali.summary: Gao-N 'tahaka axis: the FAMa neutralize armed men who racketeered travellers The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) put an end to the actions of armed men who set up illegal roadblocks on the Gao-N'tahaka axis to extort money from travellers. This operation should make it possible to strengthen security on this strategic route, heavily used by carriers and the populations of the region .

Mali.title: BAMEX 2026: Abdoulaye Maïga advocates for African security based on innovation and anticipation
Mali.summary: The Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, chaired, this Monday, November 9, 2026, at the Bamako Exhibition Centre, the opening ceremony of BAMEX 2026, dedicated to defence and security . Under the theme "Innovation, intelligence and responsiveness: Africa facing the new challenges of global security", this meeting brings together personalities from several countries around the security challenges of the continent .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: three terrorists neutralized near Nampala, several strikes in Tessalit, Nioro and Tonka
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, continue their operations to secure the territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The General Staff of the Armed Forces has taken stock of the operations carried out in the last 48 hours . On Sunday, November 8, 2026, in Kolima, 13 kilometers northeast of Nampala, an FAMa patrol neutralized three terrorists who were trying to forcibly collect zakaah from the inhabitants.

Mali.title: Confederation of Sahel States: BAMEX as a Unified Force Accelerator
Mali.summary: By focusing on the interoperability of equipment and the pooling of tactical capabilities, the Bamako gathering illustrates the unwavering political will of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger to build a community space totally secured by and for Sahelians . The guidelines recalled at the official opening by the Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence and Veterans Affairs, Major General Oumar Diarra, underline this dynamic: the rise of the Unified Force is not only based on the commitment of men to combat, but on the harmonization of their technological and logistical means .

Mali.title: The Red Cross is stepping up its assistance at reception sites
Mali.summary: CURRENTLY IN MAMARIBOUGOU, the teams of the Malian Red Cross provided food and medical assistance to people settled on the site on Friday, November 6. This operation extends the first distributions made the day before in several reception centres in the Bamako District. The note circulated by the organization quotes Ouezzinbougou, Mamaribougou and Djicoroni-Koura .

Mali.title: West Africa: Eviction of Burkinabe gold miners from Guinea - Lessons to be learned
Mali.summary: On 2 November, the Guinean authorities decided to put an end to illegal gold panning in their country, particularly in the north-east of the country. According to them, this practice poses a threat not only to the environment, but also to human and animal health. In Siguiri, for example, they say, many people have been hospitalized because of the use of cyanide Many animals have died, not to mention the massive destruction of forests and the pollution of waterways.

Mali.title: Assimi Goïta in Russia: The Malian president and Vladimir Putin’s blonde escort
Mali.summary: Footage broadcast by ORTM, Mali’s national television channel, documented Malian President Assimi Goïta during his visit to Moscow for the third Russia-Africa summit, on 28 and 29 October. Goïta watched a shooting exercise at a Russian army base. After observing the local soldiers in action, the Malian head of state took his turn.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: terrorists neutralized in the Ménaka and Kidal sectors
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 9 (AMAP) The General Staff of the Armed Forces announced on Sunday that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, have successfully carried out several strikes against groups of armed terrorist groups with war materiel, in the Ménaka and Kidal sectors, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the use of precise intelligence made it possible, on Friday, November 6, 2026, to locate a group of terrorists about 50 kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka.

Mali.title: Ménaka and Kidal: Several groupings...
Mali.summary: Menaka and Kidal: Several terrorist groups neutralized by the FAMa As part of the Dougoukoloko security operation, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted airstrikes and targeted interventions on 6 and 7 November 2026 .

Mali.title: Mali: "At one point, I stopped counting deaths," says El Bachir Thiam, a former State Security detainee
Mali.summary: In Mali, it has been a little over a year since El Bachir Thiam was released from the jails of the State Security of Mali.

Burkina Faso.title: Illegal gold panning in Guinea: 1,263 people arrested in the Siguiri region
Burkina Faso.summary: The Guinean authorities are continuing their offensive against illegal gold panning. In a joint communiqué issued on 7 November 2026 in Conakry, the Ministries of National Defence and Security and Emergency Preparedness announced the arrest of 1,263 people in the Siguiri region They include Guineans, but also Burkinabés, Malians, Togolese, Nigeriens, Ivorians and Ghanaians, presented as having refused to leave the sites.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso-EU: Ouagadougou wants humanitarian aid that leads to autonomy
Burkina Faso.summary: The Burkinabe Minister of Foreign Affairs, Karamoko Jean-Marie Traoré, met in Brussels with the European Commissioner for Humanitarian Aid, Hadja Lahbib. At the heart of the exchanges: humanitarian cooperation between Burkina Faso and the European Union. The Minister presented his country's new approach .

Burkina Faso.title: Bandits burn 12 family members
Burkina Faso.summary: Twelve members of the same family have been killed after armed bandits set their residence ablaze during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. Seven other residents were also abducted during the attack, which occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, despite efforts by the community to alert security agencies.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: A collision between two buses kills six people in Ipendo on the RN1
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso: A collision between two buses leaves six dead in Ipendo on the RN1 A traffic accident bereaved the national road No.1 (RN1) on the night of Sunday, November 8 to Monday, November 9, 2026, report our colleagues at Sidwaya Publishing. According to published information, the accident occurred in Ipendo, a village about seven kilometers from Sabou .

Niger.title: Defence and security: Presentation to the flag of the soldiers of the 2025 contingent at the Instruction and Training Center – CIE AGALI-
Niger.summary: On Friday, November 6, 2026, the Dosso Training and Education Center (CIE) hosted a solemn ceremony of presentation to the national flag of the soldiers of contingent 2025 This major event took place in the presence of many military, administrative, customary and religious authorities in the region, thus testifying to the importance given to the training and engagement of young recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN) .

Niger.title: Deployment in Niger: the EU becomes the new battleground between Algiers and Paris
Niger.summary: After EU statements on the deployment of Algerian troops in Niger, Algiers accuses Paris of being behind this position. A new diplomatic arms pass that buries a little more hopes of warming between the two countries .

Niger.title: Niger and Chad’s drone-strike row exposes deep rifts in the Sahel
Niger.summary: Niger’s junta in October accused neighbouring Chad of a drone strike that killed two civilians on its soil – and of acting with French support. Within days, the two countries’ foreign ministers were smiling side-by-side in Moscow. But differences over security and geopolitics make a swift reconciliation unlikely.

Niger.title: Niger-Chad: between Abdourahamane Tiani and Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno, the peace of the brave is not for tomorrow
Niger.summary: After the diplomatic escalation of October 26, Niamey and N’Djamena try to defuse tensions. But the security and geopolitical differences between the leaders of the two countries make a quick return to peaceful relations unlikely. Abdourahamane Tiani is an unpredictable leader On 26 October, at its initiative, the Nigerien government issued a vitriolic communiqué, accompanied by threats and warnings against its neighbour Chad.

Niger.title: Agadez: Regional Security Council meeting focused on assessing the security situation
Niger.summary: Agadez, 9 November (ANP) – The Governor of the Agadez Region, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) on Monday, 9 November 2026. Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region . The Regional Security Council, it is noted, is a body bringing together the defence and security forces and civilian personalities concerned with security issues.

significant_events.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: three terrorists neutralized near Nampala, several strikes in Tessalit, Nioro and Tonka
significant_events.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, continue their operations to secure the territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The General Staff of the Armed Forces has taken stock of the operations carried out in the last 48 hours . On Sunday, November 8, 2026, in Kolima, 13 kilometers northeast of Nampala, an FAMa patrol neutralized three terrorists who were trying to forcibly collect zakaah from the inhabitants.

Mali.title: EXPULSION OF BURKINABE orphans from Guinea: Lessons to be learned
Mali.summary: EXPULSION OF BURKINABE gold miners from Guinea: Lessons to be learned On November 2, the Guinean authorities decided to put an end to illegal gold mining in their country, especially in the Northeast of the country. According to them, this practice poses a threat not only to the environment, but also to human and animal health . In Siguiri, for example, they say, many people have been hospitalized because of the use of cyanide.

Mali.title: MALIAN ARMED FORCES: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces completes his tour of authority visits to the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA)
Mali.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, completed, on Thursday, November 5, 2026, his tour of authority in the headquarters and service directorates of the Malian Armed Forces by a step at the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA) This visit was marked by the visit of the facilities, the presentation of the latest acquisitions in equipment of the Management as well as a live intervention of the CEMGA on the antennas of the radio FAMa FM and the Web TV (FAMa TV).

Mali.title: Menaka and Kidal: Several terrorist groups neutralized by the FAMa
Mali.summary: In its statement issued this Sunday, the General Staff of the Armed Forces indicates that on Friday, November 6, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, about fifty kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka, a group of terrorists with war materials. He specifies that after confirming the target, the position was hit successfully In addition, the military hierarchy reports that on Saturday, November 7, 2026, another group of terrorists, also equipped with war materials, was identified about ninety kilometers south of the city of Kidal.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike several terrorist positions in Menaka and Kidal
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out several strikes against positions of terrorist armed groups in the regions of Menaka and Kidal, on 6 and 7 November 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, a first group of terrorists with war material was located on Friday, November 6, about 50 km southwest of Menaka.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa neutralize several terrorist groups in Menaka and Kidal
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Friday, November 6, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, about fifty (50) kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka, a group of terrorists with war materials.

Mali.title: DSSA: Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces on an official visit
Mali.summary: As part of his visits to the structures of the Malian Armed Forces, the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, accompanied by a delegation, visited the Directorate of the Social Service of the Armed Forces (DSSA) on Thursday, 5 November 2026. Upon his arrival, the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces and his delegation were welcomed by the Director of the Social Service of the Armed Forces, Colonel-Major Bréhima SAMAKÉ.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Gounzoureye: a community leader kidnapped by Al-Qaeda-linked terrorists, his son reportedly killed
Mali.summary: On April 7, 2024, armed men kidnapped Tami Moudari Touré, a local development figure in Gounzoureye (Gao region). His son was reportedly killed and his daughter allegedly subjected to physical and sexual violence. He remains unaccounted for.

Mali.title: Guinea's refouled crisis: 160,000 people registered, Mali and Burkina Faso are accelerating the...
Mali.summary: Refouled Guinea crisis: 160,000 people registered, Mali and Burkina Faso accelerate repatriation Faced with the massive influx of migrants returned from Guinea's gold mining areas, the Malian Government is moving up a gear. The Prime Minister, Head of Government chaired this Saturday, November 7, 2026, an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC) At the heart of the discussions at the CECOGEC meeting was the humanitarian situation of thousands of Africans of six nationalities expelled from Guinea and currently in transit to Mali.

Mali.title: Refouled from Guinea: Mali mobilizes 74 trucks and 21 buses for the repatriation of 15,000 gold miners
Mali.summary: The Prime Minister, Head of Government, chaired, this Saturday, November 7, 2026, an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC), devoted to the humanitarian situation of nationals of six nationalities refouled from the gold mining areas in Guinea This meeting made it possible to take stock on evacuation operations, people still present at reception sites and those already sent to Burkina Faso.

Mali.title: Anti-peeling operations in Guinea: 160,000 people returned to Mali
Mali.summary: Mali has been facing an unprecedented influx of people from the Guinean border region of Siguiri for several days, following Conakry's decision to ban illegal artisanal gold mining in several areas of the northeast and to deploy defence and security forces to enforce this measure "As of November 7, 2026, the balance sheet shows about 100,000 people in the Bamako District and nearly 60,000" in the border locality of Kourémalé, announced the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC).

Mali.title: France: Claudy Siar denounces the racism behind the expression "immigrant background"
Mali.summary: In a video published on 7 November on social networks, Claudy Siar, mission manager to Beninese President Romuald Wadagni, speaks in her personal capacity. For him, the expression "from immigration" is "probably the most racist of the moment", because it allows to say of a black or Arab French what one would never say of a white . He says he is sometimes frustrated not to be "in this furnace", and recalls his fight for more than thirty years for human dignity, regardless of skin color, religion or social background.

Mali.title: Anti-peeling operations in Guinea: 160,000 people returned to Mali
Mali.summary: Anti-peening operations in Guinea: 160,000 people turned back to Mali Mali announced on Saturday that it had received about 160,000 people turned back from Guinea after operations conducted by Conakry against illegal gold panning, stating that it had recorded six deaths and expressing concern about a situation of "humanitarian emergency" .

Burkina Faso.title: Bandits Burn 12 Family Members Alive In Zamfara Community
Burkina Faso.summary: Armed bandits have burnt 12 members of the same family to death and abducted an unspecified number of residents during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. The attack occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, where the assailants reportedly stormed the community and targeted the family of one Mallam Muhammadu Sani.

Burkina Faso.title: Bandits kill 12 family members, abduct others in Zamfara
Burkina Faso.summary: File image of bandits By Idris Salisu, Gusau Armed men suspected to be bandits have killed 12 members of the same family and abducted several residents during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. The attack reportedly occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, with the assailants setting a room ablaze after the family members reportedly locked themselves inside to avoid being abducted.

Burkina Faso.title: Guinea: 1,263 people arrested in the fight against illegal gold panning in Siguiri
Burkina Faso.summary: Guinea: 1,263 people arrested in the fight against illegal gold mining in Siguiri The operations initiated by the Guinean authorities against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in the Siguiri region are taking on a new dimension, with the arrest of 1,263 people of seven nationalities, while the campaign to secure the gold zones is causing mass departures of foreign workers and raising concerns humanitarian and diplomatic assistance in the sub-region.

Burkina Faso.title: Guinea/ Fight against illegal gold mining: 1,263 people arrested, including Burkinabe
Burkina Faso.summary: Guinea/ Fight against illegal gold mining: 1,263 people arrested, including Burkinabè The Guinean authorities announce the arrest of 1,263 people of different nationalities, including Burkinabè, in the context of operations against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in the administrative region of Siguiri . In a joint communiqué dated 7 November 2026, the Ministries of National Defence and Security and Emergency Preparedness indicate that the arrested persons were taken to Conakry for the purposes of the judicial proceedings.

Niger.title: Arlit: civil society calls on the European Union and puts on the table the consequences of more than 50 years of uranium exploitation by Orano
Niger.summary: The Arlit Civil Society Coordination reacted strongly, this Sunday, November 8, 2026, to the statements attributed to the European Union concerning military cooperation between Niger and Algeria. In a statement with a particularly firm tone, the organization denounces what it considers to be interference in the affairs of two sovereign states .

Niger.title: Tinubu condoles with Niger junta leader over father’s death
Niger.summary: President Bola Tinubu has expressed condolences to Niger Republic’s military leader, Abdourahamane Tiani, over the death of his father, Elhadji Hassane. Mr Hassane died on Thursday, 5 November, at the age of 110. In a condolence message issued by presidential spokesperson, Bayo Onanuga, Mr Tinubu said the Nigerian government and people stood in solidarity with Niger during the period of mourning.

Niger.title: Niger: former minister Kalla Moutari still in the gendarmerie, two months after his arrest
Niger.summary: In Niger, Kalla Moutari has just spent more than two months in the gendarmerie of Niamey. The former minister and well-known figure of the PNDS was arrested a few days after the destabilization attempt at the end of August 2026. According to several sources, the man has not yet been brought before a judge .

Niger.title: Defence: presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent of the Nigerien Armed Forces formed at the Groupement d 'instruction de ...
Niger.summary: The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani Kiaou, chaired, Monday, November 2, 2026, the solemn ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent of new recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN), trained at the Tondibiah Training Group, near Niamey After several months of intensive training, these new soldiers from all regions and all social strata of the country have acquired the physical, technical and tactical skills necessary to accomplish their sovereign missions in the service of the nation Now ready to defend the homeland, they officially integrate the large FAN…

Mali.title: Mali: several tens of thousands of gold miners expelled from Guinea taken care of in Mali
Mali.summary: Several tens of thousands of gold miners expelled from Guinea have arrived in Mali in recent days. This massive influx follows the measures taken on 2 November by Conakry to put an end to illegal gold mining . The Malian transitional authorities, with the support of international partners, have put in place emergency arrangements to receive these gold miners returned from Guinea and repatriate them to their homes, mainly in Burkina Faso .

Mali.title: Management of the humanitarian crisis at the border: The Malian Government mobilizes large resources for evacuation
Mali.summary: The PRIME MINISTER CHAIRS AN EXTRAORDINARY MEETING OF CECOGEC The Prime Minister, Head of Government chaired this Saturday, November 7, 2026, an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management on the humanitarian crisis following the arrival of Africans, numbering six nationalities, driven back from the gold mining areas of Guinea .

Mali.title: Murder of Safiatou Boré in Segou: a suspect arrested
Mali.summary: The investigation into the death of Safiatou Boré, known as "Safi", is progressing. A suspect was arrested in this case that upset Ségou. The young nurse had been found dead in a ditch between Dialabougou and Pelengana.

Mali.title: DGCC news flash: 665 tankers arrive in Bamako
Mali.summary: DGCC news flash: 665 tanker trucks arrive in Bamako According to the DGCC, a convoy of 665 tanker trucks arrived in Bamako on Saturday, November 7, at around 3 a.m., under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). The DGCC agents recorded and counted the tanks upon arrival. After customs formalities, the national police must escort them to the destination service stations .

Mali.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: Mali organizes repatriation and reception
Mali.summary: Faced with the humanitarian crisis caused by the expulsion of gold mining areas from Guinea, the Malian government is moving up a gear. This Saturday, the Prime Minister urgently convened the crisis committee (CECOGEC) to organize the reception and evacuation of the thousands of people concerned, from six different nationalities A first convoy of 47 buses has already reached Burkina Faso, while about fifty trucks are waiting to hit the road.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Mali – Repatriation of Africans returned from Guinea: the government mobilizes logistical resources
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 7 (AMAP) The Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, chaired an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC) on Saturday, devoted to the care of nationals of six nationalities returned from gold mining areas in Guinea, according to a statement from the Prime Minister's Office As part of this African solidarity operation, Mali mobilized 74 trucks and 21 buses.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Bla: The National Defense Forces repels a terrorist attack at the checkpoint
Mali.summary: Bla, November 7 (AMAP) The Bla checkpoint, located Ségou – Bla road, was attacked Friday around 4:45 PM, by armed terrorist groups, causing many deaths and injuries of occult forces and one death and injuries on the side of the FAMa, learned AMAP from local source According to the first testimonies collected from the agents on duty on the spot, the assailants came in number of 32, including 2 by motorcycle 16 motorcycles, opened fire without warning on the elements posted at the control.

Mali.title: GOONGA TAN: Kidal: from the return of the FAMa...
Mali.summary: GOONGA TAN: Kidal: from the return of the FAMa to the Algiers-Abou Dhabi rivalry, is the Sahel entering a new sequence? The entry of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) into Kidal unquestionably marks a major political and military turning point . It enshrines the restoration of a symbol of state authority, modifies the balance of power in the North and shakes up the speeches that, in April, presented the situation as a sign of an irreversible failure of Mali.

Mali.title: Assessment of the military operations of the Fama of mid-September 2026: The Dirpa reports 4880 fighters...
Mali.summary: Review of the military operations of the Fama of mid-September 2026: Dirpa reports 4,880 neutralized fighters and more than 162 bases destroyed During its traditional press briefing, held on Friday, October 23, 2026, the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (Dirpa) presented the review of the operations conducted by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) between May and September 2026 According to its director, Colonel-Major Boubacar Bocar Maiga, the operations made it possible to neutralize more than 4,880 fighters of the armed groups and to destroy more than 162 bases.

Burkina Faso.title: Image Africa Prohibition of clandestine gold panning in Guinea: thousands of foreigners arrested, including Malians and Burkinabe, forced to leave
Burkina Faso.summary: Thousands of foreign gold miners have been arrested in Guinea after the ban on artisanal gold mining in several areas of Siguiri. Conakry invokes environmental protection. Burkina Faso denounces expulsions and organizes the return of its nationals.

Burkina Faso.title: Behind the lull, the war continues in Burkina Faso
Burkina Faso.summary: Since July, Burkina Faso has recorded a dramatic decline in the number of deaths related to jihadist violence. The military power sees this as confirmation of its security strategy. Yet attacks persist, armed groups retain their ability to harm and civilian populations remain exposed to a war far from over .

Niger.title: No European Oversight of Algeria–Niger Sovereign Agreement
Niger.summary: The European Union’s demand for clarification over the deployment of Algerian People’s National Army units in Niger has drawn sharp criticism in Algeria. The deployment, which received parliamentary approval, falls under a bilateral military agreement between two sovereign states and was carried out at the request of the Nigerien authorities. As such, it requires neither the approval of external parties nor any accounting to institutions that have no legal standing in the agreement.

Niger.title: No European Custody of the Sovereign Agreement between Algeria and Niger
Niger.summary: There is no European guardianship over the sovereign agreement between Algeria and Niger Rahabi: What right does Europe ask for clarifications?

Niger.title: Report: Algeria's Military Deployment in Niger Redraws Lines of Rivalry with Morocco and Rift in Sahel
Niger.summary: London - “Al-Quds Al-Arabi”: The Cradle published an analytical report entitled “Algeria's Military Deployment in Niger Redraws Fault Lines in the Coast” by Aidan J. Simardon provided an analysis of Algeria's historic move with the military deployment in Niger, the backgrounds of this shift in Algerian foreign policy, and its objectives related to security and the struggle for regional influence Algeria's first declared overseas land deployment since the 1973 war represents a broader conflict over the security of the Sahel, Moroccan influence, and control of energy corridors in Africa.

Niger.title: An Algerian diplomat responds to the European Union on the deployment of the army in Niger.. What is the story?
Niger.summary: An Algerian diplomat responds to the European Union on the deployment of the army in Niger. What is the story?

Niger.title: Dosso: New soldiers of the 2025 contingent of the Agali Training and Education Center presented to the flag
Niger.summary: Dosso, 6 November (ANP) – The Dosso Training Centre (CIE) hosted this Friday, 6 November 2026, a solemn ceremony of presentation to the national flag of the soldiers of contingent 2025 This major event took place in the presence of many military, administrative, customary and religious authorities of the region, testifying to the importance given to the training and engagement of young recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN) .

Niger.title: Celebration in Agadez of the 72nd anniversary of the outbreak of the glorious Algerian Revolution
Niger.summary: Agadez, 05 November (ANP) – The Deputy Secretary General of the Governorate of Agadez, Mr. Diallo Hamidou Saidou took part, this Thursday, November 5, 2026 at the Consulate of Algeria in Agadez, in the commemorative ceremony of the 72nd anniversary of the outbreak of the glorious Algerian Revolution, initiated on November 1, 1954 .

Niger.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Niger.title: Niafunké: Two kamikaze drones miss their targets, FAMa reaction welcomed
Niger.summary: Niafunké, November 5 (AMAP)– Two kamikaze drones launched from the south of Niafunké, across the Niger River, in the direction of the city, missed their targets on Thursday. The incident resulted in a minor injury, immediately taken care of by the Defence and Security Forces (FDS), the AMAP learned from a security source . According to the information gathered, one of the machines fell into the rice fields of the Goubo rice field, while the second crashed into the concession of a resident, damaging his solar installations.

briefings.sultana_daily_text:
Good day. This is Sultana Al-Qahtani with the Sahel Desk.

Daily bottom line for 2026-11-07: Reporting collected on 2026-11-07 does not yet support a clear account of a new incident in Mali, Burkina Faso, or Niger. The desk received 18 reports from 11 sources, but the automated incident record needs further review. This is not evidence of calm on the ground.

Mali: 9 retained reports. 1. Mali: several tens of thousands of gold miners expelled from Guinea taken care of in Mali. Several tens of thousands of gold miners expelled from Guinea have arrived in Mali in recent days. This massive influx follows the measures taken on 2 November by Conakry to put an end to illegal gold mining . The Malian transitional authorities, with the support of international partners, have put in place emergency arrangements to receive these gold miners returned from Guinea and repatriate them to their homes, mainly in Burkina Faso . 2. Management of the humanitarian crisis at the border: The Malian Government mobilizes large resources for evacuation. The PRIME MINISTER CHAIRS AN EXTRAORDINARY MEETING OF CECOGEC The Prime Minister, Head of Government chaired this Saturday, November 7, 2026, an extraordinary meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management on the humanitarian crisis following the arrival of Africans, numbering six nationalities, driven back from the gold mining areas of Guinea . 3. Murder of Safiatou Boré in Segou: a suspect arrested. The investigation into the death of Safiatou Boré, known as "Safi", is progressing. A suspect was arrested in this case that upset Ségou. The young nurse had been found dead in a ditch between Dialabougou and Pelengana.

Burkina Faso: 2 retained reports. 1. Image Africa Prohibition of clandestine gold panning in Guinea: thousands of foreigners arrested, including Malians and Burkinabe, forced to leave. Thousands of foreign gold miners have been arrested in Guinea after the ban on artisanal gold mining in several areas of Siguiri. Conakry invokes environmental protection. Burkina Faso denounces expulsions and organizes the return of its nationals. 2. Behind the lull, the war continues in Burkina Faso. Since July, Burkina Faso has recorded a dramatic decline in the number of deaths related to jihadist violence. The military power sees this as confirmation of its security strategy. Yet attacks persist, armed groups retain their ability to harm and civilian populations remain exposed to a war far from over .

Niger: 7 retained reports. 1. No European Oversight of Algeria–Niger Sovereign Agreement. The European Union’s demand for clarification over the deployment of Algerian People’s National Army units in Niger has drawn sharp criticism in Algeria. The deployment, which received parliamentary approval, falls under a bilateral military agreement between two sovereign states and was carried out at the request of the Nigerien authorities. As such, it requires neither the approval of external parties nor any accounting to institutions that have no legal standing in the agreement. 2. No European Custody of the Sovereign Agreement between Algeria and Niger. There is no European guardianship over the sovereign agreement between Algeria and Niger Rahabi: What right does Europe ask for clarifications? 3. Report: Algeria's Military Deployment in Niger Redraws Lines of Rivalry with Morocco and Rift in Sahel. London - “Al-Quds Al-Arabi”: The Cradle published an analytical report entitled “Algeria's Military Deployment in Niger Redraws Fault Lines in the Coast” by Aidan J. Simardon provided an analysis of Algeria's historic move with the military deployment in Niger, the backgrounds of this shift in Algerian foreign policy, and its objectives related to security and the struggle for regional influence Algeria's first declared overseas land deployment since the 1973 war represents a broader conflict over the security of the Sahel, Moroccan influence, and control of energy corridors in Africa.

Mali.title: Mali: Delivery of a large batch of vehicles to the security forces to strengthen the protection of the territory
Mali.summary: Placed under the chairmanship of the Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, this event testifies to the unwavering desire of the authorities to provide the Armed and Security Forces with adequate logistical means to ensure the security of people and property throughout the national territory This logistical reinforcement includes 75 Toyota pick-up vehicles with single cab assigned to the Directorate General of the National Police and 25 Yamaha brand escort motorcycles assigned to the Directorate General of the National Gendarmerie.

Mali.title: Mali: One month after the takeover of Kidal, why the army has not advanced in the region
Mali.summary: In Mali, it was just a month ago on November 6 that the army and the Africa Corps took over Kidal, in the north. The city had been controlled for nearly six months by the separatists of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and their jihadist allies of the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim) While they could be expected to continue their advance in the region, Malian soldiers and their Russian partners are camped, for the time being, on their positions.

Mali.title: Mali: one month after the takeover of Kidal, why the army has not advanced in the region
Mali.summary: Mali: un mois après la reprise de Kidal, pourquoi l’armée n’a plus progressé dans la région Au Mali, cela fait tout juste un mois ce 6 novembre que l'armée et l'Africa Corps ont repris Kidal, dans le Nord. La ville était contrôlée depuis près de six mois par les indépendantistes du Front de libération de l'Azawad (FLA) et leurs alliés jihadistes du Groupe de soutien à l'islam et aux musulmans (Jnim).

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike two terrorist positions near Kouakourou and Sofara with precision
Mali.summary: Thanks to the use of precise intelligence and the coordination of operational means, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) conducted, on Thursday, November 5, 2026, two targeted actions against armed terrorist groups in the Kouakourou and Sofara sectors These interventions illustrate the continuation of efforts to secure the national territory and the determination of the Malian army to prevent any restoration of the operational capacities of terrorist groups.

Mali.title: Kouakourou and Sofara: the FAMa strike a base and a terrorist group
Mali.summary: As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their allies, continue to carry out actions to secure the territory. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on two strikes carried out on Thursday, November 5, 2026 . 6 kilometers northeast of Kouakourou, precise intelligence identified a terrorist base that housed several fighters, war materials and a fuel depot.

Mali.title: Massive influx of gold miners from Guinea: The Malian Government takes stock of the situation It was this Thursday, during a press briefing jointly hosted by the two ministers in the conference room of the Ministry of Security, that the details of this humanitarian and security crisis were shared with the
Mali.summary: Following a decision by the Guinean authorities banning traditional and illegal gold panning on their soil, Mali is facing an influx of migrants on an unprecedented scale. Nearly 80,000 people, mostly foreign nationals representing at least six nationalities, have crossed the border at Kourémalé since 2 November Faced with this critical situation that suddenly occurred, the Malian State immediately reacted under the aegis of the Prime Minister, Chairman of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management .

Mali.title: Koro, Sandaré and Sofara: Flood of fire on terrorists As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted airstrikes between 03 and 04 November 2026. These operations made it possible to target two bases of armed terrorist groups in different localities of our country.
Mali.summary: According to the statement of the General Staff of the Armed Forces published this Thursday, the exploitation of precise intelligence on Tuesday, November 03, 2026 made it possible to locate, fifty-two (52) kilometers north-east of Koro, a base of armed terrorist groups housing several individuals as well as war equipment, including motorcycles and a fuel depot .

Burkina Faso.title: AES: regional integration and economic development at the heart of exchanges between leaders
Burkina Faso.summary: The President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, paid a working visit to Burkina Faso and Niger on 5 November 2026. The purpose of this trip was to consolidate relations between the three member countries of the Confederation of Sahelian States AES and to strengthen their cooperation in several areas . In both Ouagadougou and Niamey, discussions focused on security, regional integration and economic development.

Burkina Faso.title: Mali-Burkina: Assimi Goïta and Ibrahim Traoré strengthen their cooperation
Burkina Faso.summary: The President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, made an official visit to Burkina Faso on Thursday, November 5, 2026. In Ouagadougou, he was received by the President of Faso and current President of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), Captain Ibrahim Traoré. This is what emerges from the joint communiqué issued at the end of the visit .

Burkina Faso.title: AES: regional integration and economic development at the heart of exchanges between leaders

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: King Gan "officially" declared "dead" four years after his abduction
Burkina Faso.summary: The Gan king of the village of Obiré was declared “officially dead” four years after his abduction, reports Bafujinfo, on Thursday, November 5, 2026. "Kidnapped on September 27, 2022 with his son while they were returning from the field, King Gan of Obiré is now officially declared dead by the sages of the royal court," wrote the regional newspaper of Djôrô which also announces a period of mourning for the entire Gan community since the first funeral started last night while waiting for the big funeral scheduled in three months.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: 200 new tractors to accelerate agricultural mechanization
Burkina Faso.summary: To accelerate the mechanization of Burkina Faso's agriculture, the National Office for Major Projects handed over a large batch of agricultural equipment, mainly tractors, to the Ministry of Agriculture on Friday, November 6, 2026. In total, 200 tractors with a power of 40 horses, accompanied in particular by plows and harrows, were handed over to the department in charge of Agriculture .

Burkina Faso.title: Guinea: "Anarchic" gold panning banned in the north-east, Ouagadougou denounces the eviction of Burkinabe
Burkina Faso.summary: In recent days, thousands of gold miners have left the Siguiri region in northeastern Guinea, an area rich in gold that attracts many West African nationals. These mass departures come after the measures taken on 2 November by the Guinean authorities to put an end to illegal gold mining These gold miners, mainly Burkinabe, have found refuge in neighboring Mali, from where their government organizes their repatriation.

Burkina Faso.title: The terrorism-proof bronze showcase
Burkina Faso.summary: Bronziers and other artisans in the city of Ouagadougou are thinking about solutions for the sale of their products. The craft sector is hard hit by the consequences of the security crisis in view of the scarcity of tourists. Professionals in the field are developing initiatives and now rest their hopes on Burkinabés.

Burkina Faso.title: Guinea: "anarchic" gold panning banned in the north-east, Ouagadougou denounces the eviction of Burkinabe
Burkina Faso.summary: Guinea: "anarchic" gold panning banned in the north-east, Ouagadougou denounces the expulsion of Burkinabe In recent days, thousands of gold miners have left the Siguiri region in north-east Guinea, an area rich in gold that attracts many West African nationals. These mass departures come after the measures taken on 2 November by the Guinean authorities to put an end to illegal gold mining These gold miners, mainly Burkinabe, have found refuge in neighboring Mali, from where their government organizes their repatriation.

Burkina Faso.title: Mouhoun: The garrison of Dédougou commemorates the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces under the sign of sovereign defense
Burkina Faso.summary: BURKINA-MOUHOUN-ARMEE-ANNIVERSAIRE-COMMEMORATION Mouhoun: The garrison of Dédougou commemorates the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces under the sign of sovereign defense Dédougou, Nov 1 . 2026 (AIB)-The garrison of Dédougou celebrated on Sunday, November 1, 2026, the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces (FAN) through a ceremony of taking up arms under the theme "National Armed Forces and military reserve for a sovereign defense of the Fatherland" .

Niger.title: Zinder/Defense: Official presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent at the CI/FAN of Aroungouza
Niger.summary: The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani Kiaou, presided, on November 4, 2026, at the Zinder Training Center, in Aroungouza, the solemn ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN), in the presence of the Governor of the Zinder region, Colonel Massalatchi Mahaman Sani, as well as several military, administrative and customary officials .

Niger.title: Niger: EU calls on Algeria to deploy its troops
Niger.summary: At the daily press briefing of the European Commission in Brussels on Friday 30 October 2026, the European Union Spokesperson for Foreign Affairs, Anouar El Anouni, reacted to the sending of Algerian soldiers to Niger. Brussels said it was monitoring the situation closely and asked for clarification on the scope, objective and basis of this operation. .

Niger.title: The think tank CEDYS calls for a diplomatic approach to defuse tensions between Chad and Niger
Niger.summary: In its Policy Brief published in October 2026, entitled "Tensions between Chad and Niger catalyze regional insecurity", the Centre for the Study of Social Dynamics (CEDYS) warns of the risks posed by the growing tensions between N’Djamena and Niamey to the security of the central Sahel Written by Yamingué Betinbaye, Ndilbé Mbaïnguem François and Babouh Tih-Kwada Elisabeth, the document believes that these frictions, fuelled by reciprocal accusations and differences in international alliances, hinder the pooling of efforts in the face of common threats.

Niger.title: Niger receives 1.65 million litres of Algerian fuel
Niger.summary: - Daba Finance, 5 November 2026 Niger received its first delivery of fuel from Algeria: 53 tankers transported 1.65 million litres of products… More »Niger received its first delivery of fuel from Algeria: 53 tankers transported 1.65 million litres of petroleum products to the city of Agadez, in the north of the country, as it seeks to alleviate fuel shortages and to strengthen its energy cooperation with its northern neighbour.

Niger.title: Niger: Niger receives 1.65 million litres of Algerian fuel as shortage persists
Niger.summary: Niger received its first delivery of fuel from Algeria: 53 tankers transported 1.65 million liters of petroleum products to the northern city of Agadez, as the country seeks to alleviate fuel shortages and strengthen its energy cooperation with its northern neighbor . The convoy arrived on October 31, 2026, under military escort from both countries, according to the Nigerien public channel RTN.

Niger.title: Sahel: Algeria intensifies its offensive...
Niger.summary: Sahel: Algeria intensifies its diplomatic offensive in Niger and Chad After N'Djamena, the head of Algerian diplomacy went to Niamey to strengthen bilateral relations and promote regional coordination around the security and economic challenges of the Sahel . 06 Nov 2026 - 07:03 1 The Algerian Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Attaf, paid an official visit to Niamey on Wednesday, the day after his visit to Chad.

Niger.title: Niger: Niger Receives 1.65m Liters of Algerian Fuel As Shortages Persist
Niger.summary: Niger has received its first shipment of fuel from Algeria, with 53 tanker trucks delivering 1.65 million liters of petroleum products to the northern city of Agadez as the country seeks to ease fuel shortages and strengthen energy cooperation with its northern neighbor. The convoy arrived on October 31, 2026, under military escort from both countries, according to Niger's state broadcaster RTN.
