Mali.title: Return of the Burkinabe gold miners from Guinea: the Prime Minister chairs a crisis meeting
Mali.summary: The Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, chaired this Thursday, November 5, 2026, a meeting of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management (CECOGEC). Only one subject was on the agenda: the massive arrival in Mali of Burkinabe nationals expelled from gold mining sites in Guinea . Faced with this situation, the Government activated its crisis management mechanisms.

Mali.title: Gold miners from Guinea: Bamako facing the influx
Mali.summary: RIGHT NOW "We are a family in Mali, but our wish is to return home," says Yacouba Sawadogo, a Burkinabe gold miner who arrived after leaving Guinea. Since 29 October, the Guinean authorities have suspended artisanal gold panning in the Siguiri region, citing environmental degradation, pollution of waterways and the use of machines incompatible with artisanal mining .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike several terrorist positions and continue their offensive to secure the national territory
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely pursuing their mission of defending territorial integrity and protecting populations. As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, units engaged on the ground maintain sustained operational pressure against armed terrorist groups, through surveillance, intelligence, reconnaissance and targeted strikes The latest operations, conducted on 3 and 4 November 2026 in several sectors of the national territory, testify to the continuity of the military commitment and the willingness of the military authorities to leave no space for the terrorist threat .

Mali.title: Prohibited gold panning in Guinea: Bamako and Ouagadougou agree on the return of their nationals
Mali.summary: Thousands of Malian and Burkinabe gold miners leave Guinea and flow back to Mali. Since the suspension of artisanal gold panning decided by the Guinean authorities in the Siguiri area, the Malian border localities have seen the arrival of convoys of people forced to return This Wednesday, November 4, 2026, Burkina Faso sent a ministerial delegation to Bamako, while Mali claims to have made arrangements to welcome and assist the people concerned.

Mali.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: the CNDH calls for the protection of migrants, especially children and young people
Mali.summary: The National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) is concerned about the arrival in Mali, since November 3, 2026, of many migrants mainly from gold mining sites in Guinea . In a communiqué published on 04 November 2026, the institution reminds the State of its obligations in terms of humanitarian assistance, based on the Malian Constitution and several international and African human rights protection texts.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Guinea: Ambassadors invited to a meeting in the context of operations in Siguiri
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 5 (AMAP) Guinean Foreign Minister Morissanda Kouyaté on Thursday invited heads of diplomatic missions accredited to Guinea to a meeting devoted to issues of common interest and the strengthening of international cooperation, in a context marked by the departure of foreign workers from the Siguiri region Announced in a statement dated 5 November, this meeting comes after the launch of operations against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in this region of the north-east of the country.

Mali.title: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara: the FAMa strike...
Mali.summary: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara: the FAMa strike three terrorist positions in two days In a statement dated November 5, 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced two bases destroyed by precision strikes, near Koro and Sandaré, as well as a pair of terrorists on motorcycles targeted northwest of Sofara, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . The operations of surveillance, control and security of the territory continue.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Kouremalé: The authorities of Faso welcome the "total and unconditional" assistance to more than 40,000 Burkinabe gold miners expelled from Guinea
Mali.summary: Kangaba, November 5 (AMAP) The Malian authorities have mobilized their services to provide assistance to more than 40,000 Burkinabe nationals expelled from gold mining sites in Guinea and arrived in Kouremalé, in the rural commune of Benkadi . The adviser at the Embassy of Burkina Faso in Mali, Ramdé Antoine, and the delegate to the Council of Burkinabè of the Koulikoro region, Daouda Ouattara, welcomed the "total and unconditional" assistance of the Malian authorities, particularly those of Kouremalé, noted AMAP .

Mali.title: Mali: President Goïta endows several defence services with new rolling means
Mali.summary: On the sidelines of the commemoration of the National Day of Wards, this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Head of State, proceeded, at the Koulouba Palace, to the delivery of rolling means to several defense services .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike terrorist bases near Koro, Sandaré and Sofara
Mali.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike terrorist bases near Koro, Sandaré and Sofara As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their allies continue to carry out missions to secure the country. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on several strikes carried out in recent days. On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, a terrorist base was spotted 52 kilometers northeast of Koro .

Mali.title: Koulouba: the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces provides several defence services with new rolling means
Mali.summary: Nine (9) buses and six (6) pick-ups were handed over by the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces to the Armed Forces Social Service, the Banankoro NCO School (ESO), the Military Police, the Directorate of Armed Forces Information and Public Relations (DIRPA), the Special Operations Command (COS), the Directorate of Military Sports, the Staff School, the Military Police and the Directorate of Armed Forces Music .

Mali.title: Koulouba: the President of the Transition offers vehicles to the Defence Services
Mali.summary: On the occasion of the National Day of Wards this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, handed over nine buses and six pick-ups intended for the Defence Services, at the Koulouba Palace . These vehicles are intended in particular for the Social Service of the Armed Forces, the School of Non-Commissioned Officers of Banankoro, the Military Prytanée, the DIRPA, the Special Operations Command, the Military Police and the Directorate of the Music of the Armed Forces .

Mali.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: Mali and Burkina Faso organize the return of Burkinabe
Mali.summary: Rejected miners from Guinea: Mali and Burkina Faso organize the return of Burkinabe The Malian Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, received on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 a Burkinabe delegation led by his counterpart, the Divisional Commissioner of Police Mahamadou Sana . The Burkinabe Minister of Family and Solidarity, Lieutenant-Colonel Passowendé Pélagie Kaboré, was also part of the delegation.

Mali.title: Koulouba: General Assimi GOÏTA hands over a batch of vehicles to several army departments
Mali.summary: Koulouba: the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces endows several defense services with new rolling means On the sidelines of the commemoration of the National Day of Wards, this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, His Excellency Army General Assimi GOÏTA, Head of State, proceeded, at the Palace of Koulouba, to the delivery of rolling means to several defense services .

Mali.title: Mali: Kouremalé faced with the influx of thousands of people from Guinea
Mali.summary: The suspension of artisanal gold panning in Siguiri prefecture, Guinea, caused the forced return of thousands of foreign gold miners, including Malians and Burkinabe. Faced with this influx, the authorities announce measures to welcome the people concerned, provide them with assistance and facilitate their return to their respective countries In a statement issued on Tuesday, November 3, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) ensures that arrangements are made to assist the nationals concerned and organize their return.

Mali.title: MILITARY COURT OF BAMAKO: eight cases considered at the correctional hearing
Mali.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at its headquarters located in Dar Salam, in the 3rd district of the District of Bamako, its ordinary correctional hearing. A total of eight (08) cases were on the docket, involving several military and civilian personnel for various acts relating to Military Justice. The hearing was presided over by Magistrate Assama DOLO, assisted by his colleagues .

Burkina Faso.title: Song-Taaba Cooperative: Biscuits to Support SDS and VDP at the Front
Burkina Faso.summary: Originally from the Nakambé region, the "Song-Taaba" cooperative company in Tenkodogo has a great affluence. At the show, it presents a range of processed products highlighting the potential of local cereals According to the head of the Song-Taaba cooperative, based in the No.1 sector of Tenkodogo in the Nakambe region, Larba Tarnagda Nagalo, participation in this 18th edition of the Ouagadougou International Crafts Fair (SIAO) aims to promote the flavors of her region .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: in Soubo, a gold mine burned in retaliation for abuses against the Fulani, according to witnesses
Burkina Faso.summary: In a statement released on November 4, Human Rights Watch documented the September 1 JNIM attack on a gold mining site in northern Burkina Faso, which claimed the lives of 24 civilians.

Burkina Faso.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Burkina Faso.title: Gold miners expelled from Guinea: At least four dead and a hundred sick
Burkina Faso.summary: Kangaba, Nov. 5 (AMAP)– At least four people have lost their lives and a hundred more are being treated at the Kouremalé Community Health Centre (CSCOM), among thousands of gold miners expelled from gold mining sites in Siguiri, Guinea. Some of the wounded treated in this structure were hit by live ammunition .

Burkina Faso.title: Thousands of Burkinabe repatriated from Guinea after measures against illegal gold panning
Burkina Faso.summary: Guinea's gold mines attract many West African nationals, including Burkinabè. But on Monday, the Guinean government announced a formal ban on artisanal gold mining in several areas in the north-east of the country, as well as the permanent deployment of defence and security forces to enforce this measure. However, the Guinean authorities have not communicated on these population movements .

Burkina Faso.title: Withdrawal of driving licences: about forty files examined
Burkina Faso.summary: La Direction générale des transports terrestres et maritimes (DGTTM) a tenu la troisième session foraine de la Commission technique spéciale de retrait du permis de conduire (CTSRPC), le lundi 26 octobre 2026, à la gare routière de Boromo. L’ouverture de la session de 48h a été présidée par le haut-commissaire de la province, Martin Bado, représentant le gouverneur de la région de Bankui.

Burkina Faso.title: Bam: the High Commissioner salutes the generosity of the CEO of Serval Sécurité towards the VDPs of Zimtanga
Burkina Faso.summary: Bam: the High Commissioner salutes the generosity of the CEO of Serval Sécurité towards the VDP of Zimtanga Kongoussi, Oct. 31, 2026 (AIB)- The High Commissioner of the province of Bam, Karim Ouédraogo, welcomed on Friday, October 30, 2026 in Kongoussi the generosity of the President and CEO of Serval Sécurité, Harouna Sawadogo . The latter offered food, a financial envelope and security equipment to the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP) of Zimtanga, to support their commitment to securing the territory.

Niger.title: Niger–Mali: Tiani and Goïta reaffirm their commitment to strengthening the ESA and the fight against terrorism
Niger.summary: The Presidents of Niger and Mali, Army Generals Abdourahamane Tiani and Assimi Goïta, reaffirmed, Thursday in Niamey, their determination to consolidate the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), to intensify the fight against terrorism and to strengthen security, diplomatic and economic cooperation between member countries This common will emerges from the joint communiqué issued at the end of the official visit to Niger by the President of Mali, at the invitation of his Nigerien counterpart .

Mali.title: Hydrocarbons in Kayes: Resumption of supply
Mali.summary: Kayes, November 4 (AMAP)– Fuel supply has resumed normally in the Kayes Region after two days of disruption. A convoy of several tanker trucks arrived Tuesday, November 3 in the city, around 11 am, under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), announced the Regional Directorate of Trade . According to the Regional Director of Trade, Robo Bayo, this arrival has strengthened existing stocks at gas stations and outlets, ensuring continuity of supply throughout the region.

Mali.title: Image Africa Illegal gold panning: thousands of Burkinabe repatriated from Guinea
Mali.summary: Burkina Faso is organizing the repatriation of thousands of its nationals from Guinea from this week with the help of Mali, after the prohibition of artisanal gold mining in several areas of the north-east of the country. The Burkinabe Minister of Security is in Bamako on November 4. A sieve with gold glitter .

Mali.title: Burkinabe returnees from Guinea: a government delegation on mission in Bamako
Mali.summary: The Burkinabe Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana, visited Bamako on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 to inquire about the situation of several thousand compatriots returned from Guinea and to organize their return to Burkina Faso. Burkina Faso's Minister of Security, Police Divisional Commissioner Mahamadou Sana, was received on Wednesday in Bamako by his Malian counterpart, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine Mandated by President Ibrahim Traoré, he came to examine the conditions of care of young Burkinabe gold miners who arrived in Mali after their expulsion from Guinea, according to the Malian Armed Forces.

Mali.title: Military Court of Bamako: eight cases examined in correctional hearing
Mali.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held its ordinary correctional hearing on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, under the chairmanship of Magistrate Assama Dolo. Eight files, involving military and civilians, were on the docket . The cases included acts of fraud, breach of trust, slanderous denunciation, loss of weapons, desertion, disobedience, escape of detainees and violation of military instructions.

Mali.title: Mali: Kouremalé faced with the influx of thousands of people from Guinea
Mali.summary: The suspension of artisanal gold panning in Siguiri prefecture, Guinea, caused the forced return of thousands of foreign gold miners, including Malians and Burkinabe. Faced with this influx, the authorities announce measures to welcome the people concerned, provide them with assistance and facilitate their return to their respective countries In a statement issued on Tuesday, November 3, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) ensures that arrangements are made to assist the nationals concerned and organize their return.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Illegal gold panning: Hundreds of Africans driven from Guinea arrive in Bamako
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP)– African nationals, mostly from a member country of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), arrive in Bamako after leaving gold mining sites in Guinea, following measures taken by the Guinean authorities against clandestine and illegal mining . At the Djicoroni-Para autogare, several of them are waiting to find the necessary means to return to Burkina Faso, AMAP noted.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: South Africa: increased security for municipal elections
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP) South African security forces have been placed on heightened alert for Wednesday's municipal elections, after 21 incidents recorded during the special vote, according to the National Joint Operations and Intelligence Structure (NATJOINTS) . Events reported on Monday and Tuesday include killings, theft of election materials, arson, intimidation and damage to campaign materials.

Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) conducted three (03) aerial interventions resulting in four (04) strikes against positions of terrorist armed groups in the sectors of Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous The operations, carried out on November 2 and 3, 2026, (…)By Mahamane TOURE – NEW HORIZONRETROUVE the REST OF YOUR ARTICLE IN the NEW HORIZON OF WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 4, 2026 Follow us on Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp to miss nothing of Malian news Follow us on Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp to miss nothing of Malian news

Mali.summary: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous: the Noose is tightening around terrorist groups As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out airstrikes in different localities of our country between 2 and 3 November 2026 . In a statement issued yesterday by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, it appears that on Monday, November 2, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, thirty kilometers east of Niono, a major base housing armed terrorist groups as well as war material, including armed vehicles.

Mali.title: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous: the Noose is tightening around terrorist groups As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out airstrikes in different localities of our country between 2 and 3 November 2026.
Mali.summary: In a statement issued yesterday by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, it appears that on Monday, November 2, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, thirty kilometers east of Niono, a large base housing armed terrorist groups as well as war equipment, including armed vehicles. After confirming the collected information, the position has been processed successfully On the same day, twenty-eight kilometers south of Tessalit, a terrorist assembly point housing several individuals and war materiel was precisely spotted and struck.

Mali.title: 2nd coordination meeting of the military frequencies of the ESA countries: The work opened in Bamako The Minister of Communication, the Digital Economy and the Modernization of the Administration, Alhamdou Ag Ilyène, took part, on Monday, November 2, 2026, in Bamako, in the opening ceremony of the second coordination meeting of the military frequencies of the member countries of the Confederation of Sahel States (ESA).
Mali.summary: A view of the Presidium at the opening ceremony The ceremony was presided over by the Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence and Veterans Affairs, Major General Oumarou Diarra, in the presence of the President of the Telecommunications, Information and Communication Technologies and Posts Regulatory Authority of Mali (AMRTP), Saïdou Pona Sankaré . Organised by AMRTP from 2 to 4 November 2026, this strategic meeting aims to strengthen cooperation between Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger in the management and coordination of radio frequencies used by the Defence and Security Forces .

Mali.title: Guinea: 22 directors expelled for complicity in illegal gold panning in Siguiri
Mali.summary: Guinea: 22 directors removed for complicity in illegal gold panning in Siguiri The Guinean President, Mamadi Doumbouya, signed on November 3, 2026 a decree deleting 22 territorial administrators, civilian and military, stationed in the Siguiri region. They are permanently excluded from the civil service and the defence and security forces The spokesman of the Presidency, General Amara Camara, read the decree on national television (RTG).

Mali.title: Mali-Guinea: an influx of foreign nationals reported at the border
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP) A large influx of nationals of various nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and Guinea, towards the District of Bamako, announced Wednesday the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC), in a statement of the Inter-Ministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management This situation follows the measures taken by the Guinean authorities to put an end to clandestine and illegal gold panning on their territory, says the communiqué issued at the end of an emergency meeting held at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection, under the chairmanship of…

Mali.title: Mali-Guinea: An influx of gold miners at the Kouremale border, CECOGEC announces reception measures...
Mali.summary: Mali-Guinea: Flux of gold miners at the Kouremale border, CECOGEC announces reception and repatriation measures The Ministry of Security and Civil Protection is sounding the alarm . In a press release No. 2026-05 published on November 3, 2026 and signed by Colonel Fireman Issa Raoul Dana DABO, the Center for Coordination and Crisis Management (CECOGEC) reports a large influx of nationals of various nationalities on the border between Mali and Guinea, towards the District of Bamako .

Mali.title: Mali-Guinea Border Migration: Security Authorities Take Charge
Mali.summary: COMMUNIQUÉ No. 2026-05 OF the INTERMINISTERIEL Committee FOR CRISIS and DISASTER MANAGEMENT Following an emergency meeting held today at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection chaired by the Secretary General, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) informs national public opinion that a large influx of nationals of various nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and the Guinea, towards Bamako District.

Mali.title: Between Us: Realism
Mali.summary: By press release dated 24 October 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced the discovery, in a camp in Tagadayat about 35 km south-east of the city of Menaka, of 54 lifeless bodies . A week earlier, on October 19, the Executive Office of the Idaksahak Community spoke of "the massacre of 48 civilians, which occurred on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in the locality of Tagadayat, in the region of Menaka, by armed elements of Daesh, arrived on board several motorcycles" .

Burkina Faso.title: HRW Demands Burkina Faso Govt Probe Civilian Killings
Burkina Faso.summary: Human Rights Watch (HRW) has urged Burkinabe authorities to strengthen protections for vulnerable communities, investigate human rights abuses, and "fairly prosecute" those responsible following a wave of attacks by an Al-Qaeda-linked armed group that killed dozens of civilians. According to HRW, fighters from the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) attacked a gold mining site on September 1, killing 24 people.

Burkina Faso.title: Nouga: six Burkinabe gold miners die in the collapse of a gallery
Burkina Faso.summary: Six people, all of Burkinabe nationality, lost their lives in the collapse of a mining well transformed into a gallery, on an isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou, in the rural commune of Nouga, in the circle of Kangaba . According to Essor, as soon as he was informed, the prefect of the circle went on site with the officials of the police, gendarmerie, national guard, civil protection and other technical services.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso repatriates more than 8,000 nationals of Guinea after the ban on gold panning
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso repatriates more than 8,000 nationals from Guinea after gold panning ban The Burkinabe government has mobilized a convoy of hundreds of buses to repatriate more than 8,000 nationals from Guinea, in response to the ban on artisanal gold mining and a situation of increasing distress Burkina Faso is organizing the repatriation of thousands of its nationals from Guinea this week, after measures taken by Conakry against illegal gold panning, AFP learned Wednesday from a source in the Burkinabe government and a state media.

Burkina Faso.summary: - Burkina Faso: Islamist armed group targeted civilians HRW, 4 November 2026 GSIM carried out a deadly attack on a mine site, and evidently used banned explosive devices in a northern province Plus' GSIM carried out a deadly attack on a mine site, and evidently used banned explosive devices in a northern province An al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Yatenga province, northern Burkina Faso, in September 2026.

Burkina Faso.title: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide...
Burkina Faso.summary: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide of a mining well in Nouga Six people died last Friday in the landslide of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga, precisely on a very isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou. According to our information, the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso Immediately informed, the Prefect of Circle, accompanied by the officials of the Police, the National Gendarmerie, the National Guard, the Civil Protection Rescue Center, the sanitation and water and forest services, went to the scene.

Burkina Faso.summary: The fighting forces launched an offensive against the terrorists affiliated with the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (GSIM), entrenched in the Konga forest in the Sourou. Burkina Faso.summary: GSIM carried out a deadly attack on a mine site, and clearly used banned explosive devices in a northern province - An al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Yatenga province, northern Burkina Faso, in September 2026. - Unrelenting illegal attacks by GSIM put civilians at serious risk across Burkina Faso . Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Two fiancés die in Tenkodogo after an altercation involving a firearm
Burkina Faso.summary: A trader and a non-commissioned officer of the defense and security forces, presented as fiancés, died at the Tenkodogo Regional Hospital Center (CHR) after an altercation that occurred on the night of November 1 to 2, 2026 in Sector 6, according to testimonies collected by the Burkina Faso Information Agency (AIB) . Burkina Faso.title: Field-tested, the Burkinabe army has developed "unique combat modes in the world", PM
Burkina Faso.summary: In the field, the Burkinabe army has developed "unique combat modes in the world", PM Ouagadougou, Oct. 30, 2026 (AIB)-The Burkinabe Combat Forces have developed, thanks to the experience gained in the field, unique combat modes in the world that they can share with their Russian brothers, welcomed Prime Minister Rimtalba Jean Emmanuel Ouédraogo, during an interview in Moscow with Russian television RT .

Niger.title: Chadian president meets Algerian foreign minister in Ndjamena
Niger.summary: Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Deby Itno on Tuesday met with Algerian Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf at the presidential palace in N'Djamena. The two countries discussed enhancing bilateral and the implementation of cooperation agreements signed during Deby's visit to Algiers last year. Observers say Algeria, which this week deployed troops to Niger seeks to regain influence in the Sahel.

Niger.summary: Algerian diplomat: The completion of the Nigerian part of the trans-Saharan gas pipeline will start soon - Enhancing security and economic cooperation: Algeria strengthens cooperation with Niger to confront terrorist threats, and supports the re-establishment in Niger through training programs, which enhances the economic partnership after signing twenty cooperation agreements - Integrative projects and economic initiatives: Algeria supports African integration with projects such as the Trans-Saharan Road and a railway line towards Niamey, with a joint military agreement to enhance security and protect energy…

Niger.title: Niger: after military support, Algeria launches mediation with Chad
Niger.summary: Algeria is stepping up its involvement in the security challenges of the Sahel. After strengthening its military cooperation with Niger, Algiers now seems to favor the diplomatic route to bring Niamey and N’Djamena, whose relations are marked by tensions. It is certainly in this perspective that Ahmed Attaf, Algerian Minister of Foreign Affairs, paid a visit to Chad and then Niger Indeed, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, he went to N’Djamena as special envoy of President Abdelmadjid Tebboune where he was received by Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno.

Niger.title: Niger signs cooperation deal with military leader in eastern Libya
Niger.summary: Niger signed a memorandum of understanding with eastern Libya’s military commander Khalifa Haftar on Sunday to strengthen their bilateral relations. The agreement to expand cooperation in “various fields” was approved by Nigerien Prime Minister Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine. He visited Benghazi together with several political and military officials.

Niger.title: An example of cooperation :
Niger.summary: This is an example of South-South cooperation that must do its bit on the African continent. Algeria has decided to provide military support to its neighbour, Niger, with which it had, until recently, tense relations. If relations between the two had been somewhat blurred, pragmatism eventually took over, giving way to a return to a warming of cooperation between the two countries .

Mali.title: Nigeria: Five law enforcement officers killed in an ambush in the northwest
Mali.summary: Bamako, Nov. 3 (AMAP) Five Nigerian law enforcement officers were killed Monday night in an ambush by gunmen on the Sokoto-Gusau axis in the northwest of the country while on their way to neighboring Zamfara state, according to a police spokesman. They were riding on a Zamfara transit bus when assailants intercepted the vehicle and opened fire Police spokesman Abdullahi Faruk confirmed the attack and said the bodies of the victims had been dropped off at the morgue at Usmanu Danfodiyo University Hospital in Sokoto.

Mali.title: Africa: China provides sophisticated military equipment to African countries, including Mali and Burkina Faso
Mali.summary: China is no longer content to invest in Africa: it is also deploying its military power there. From rifles to armed drones, from armoured vehicles to air defence systems: Beijing is now providing African armies with increasingly sophisticated equipment, particularly in Mali and Burkina Faso But the continent is also becoming a strategic training ground for the Chinese army, which is seeking to demonstrate its ability to intervene far from its borders.

Mali.title: Mali: NGOs call on the Transition on the kidnapping of Mountaga Tall (RFI)
Mali.summary: In Mali, it has been six months, this Tuesday, November 2, that the lawyer and former minister Mountaga Tall, committed to the defense of democracy, was kidnapped, at home, by hooded men of the State Security. Other pro-democracy activists kidnapped by State Security last May have recently reappeared. Their health worries.

Mali.title: JNIM Claims IED Attack on Malian Army and Africa Corps Vehicle Between Sévaré and Konna
Mali.summary: Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), al-Qaeda's Sahel affiliate, says it targeted a vehicle carrying Malian army and Russian Africa Corps personnel with an improvised explosive device on the morning of Monday, 2 November 2026. The claimed strike took place on the road between Sévaré and Konna in Mali's Mopti region. Casualties, damage and even the exact location rest on JNIM's claim alone and should be treated as unverified.

Mali.title: Mali: Six months after their abduction, Mountaga Tall and her son remain unaccounted for
Mali.summary: The Malian authorities must urgently reveal the fate and whereabouts of pro-democracy lawyer and politician Mountaga Tall and her son Cheick Mamadou Tall, Amnesty International said six months after their abductions On the night of May 3, 2026, a few days after a wave of attacks by armed groups in several regions of Mali, Mountaga Tall, leader of the National Congress for Democratic Initiative, was abducted from his home in the capital, Bamako, by armed and hooded men travelling in vehicles without license plates.

Mali.title: Mali: nearly 4,000 displaced after the attack on the village of Souleye
Mali.summary: In Mali, nearly 4,000 displaced people have found refuge in Macina and Sarro, in the Ségou region in the centre of the country. These are mainly women and children who fled the attack on the village of Souleye, carried out in early September by hundreds of jihadist fighters. On the spot, solidarity is organized, but the needs remain immense .

Mali.title: Gao: a young man attacked in his sleep in front of a butcher shop

They allegedly threatened him with a weapon and tried to strangle him with a turban, before seizing a large sum of money and fleeing.

Mali.summary: Mountaga Tall was kidnapped on the night of 2 to 3 May. A few days later, the Malian services kidnapped her son, who has also been detained since, in an unknown location outside of any legal procedure. Mali.title: Mali: Mountaga Tall kidnapped by State Security for six months, NGOs call on the Transitional authorities
Mali.summary: Mali: Mountaga Tall kidnapped by the State Security for six months, NGOs call on the Transitional authorities In Mali, it has been six months, this Tuesday, November 2, that the lawyer and former minister Mountaga Tall, committed to the defense of democracy, was kidnapped, at home, by hooded men of the State Security. Mali.title: Abduction of Mountaga Tall in Mali: silence "does not erase the competences of justice or the obligations of the State"
Mali.summary: In Mali, it was six months ago, on Tuesday, that the lawyer and former minister Mountaga Tall, committed to the defense of democracy, was kidnapped from his home, at night, by hooded men of the State Security. It was the night of 2 to 3 May. A few days after him, the Malian services kidnapped his son, also detained since in an unknown place outside any legal procedure .

Mali.title: Mali: Still No Accountability Six Months After Abduction of Pro-Democracy Politician Mountaga Tall and His Son
Mali.summary: Malian authorities must urgently disclose the fate and whereabouts of lawyer and pro-democracy politician Mountaga Tall and his son Cheick Mamadou Tall, Amnesty International said six months after their abductions. On the night of 3 May 2026, just days after a series of attacks by armed groups across Mali, Mountaga Tall, leader of the National Congress for the Democratic Initiative (Congrès national pour l'initiative démocratique), was abducted from his home in the capital, Bamako, by armed and hooded men driving vehicles without registration plates.

Burkina Faso.title: Ghana: a deadly explosion kills several people near the Burkinabe border
Burkina Faso.summary: An explosion involving a tricycle carrying suspected explosives killed several people on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, in Hamile, Upper West Region, Ghana. One immigration officer lost his life in the drama, while another was seriously injured. The locality of Hamile, located near the border between Ghana and Burkina Faso, was shaken by a deadly explosion .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: terrorist leader Djabiri...
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso: terrorist leader Djabiri Mangan, known as "Le Borgne", neutralized by special forces The Burkina Faso Armed Forces have just dealt a new blow to the armed groups of the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM). .. Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: in one month, the National Police collected more than 99 million CFA francs during an operation
Burkina Faso.summary: On the morning of Monday, November 2, 2026, the Director of Public Security (DSP), the Divisional Police Commissioner Sibiri Nébilè Amidou YOIN, led a press briefing at the Regional Directorate of the National Police of Kadiogo (DRPN-K). Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Saïdou Diallo, alias "Djabiri Mangan", GSIM officer, killed during an operation in Sourou
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso: Saidou Diallo, alias "Djabiri Mangan", GSIM officer, killed during an operation in Sourou Saidou Diallo, alias Djabiri Mangan, known as "the One-eyed", presented as a senior official of the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (GSIM), was killed on Thursday, October 29, 2026 in the Konga forest, in the commune of Gomboro, Sourou province According to the Burkina Information Agency (AIB), which cites security sources, the operation was carried out by the Special Anti-Terrorist Field Forces (FORSATEC).

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina/Fight against terrorism: VDP Younga Yacouba honored for his bravery in combat
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso/Fight against terrorism: The VDP Younga Yacouba honored for his bravery in combat According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Burkina Faso, the Volunteer for the Defense of the Fatherland (VDP) Younga Yacouba showed courage and determination during an attack on a position in the village of Youba, where he was engaged in a support mission .

Niger.title: Niger: 1,245 deaths in road accidents in 2025
Niger.summary: In Niger, 1,245 people lost their lives in road accidents in 2025, according to data from the Nigerien Road Safety Agency (ANISER), reported by the Nigerien Press Agency (ANP) on November 2, 2026. Niger.title: Presentation to the national flag of the soldiers of the 2025 FAN contingent: The Nigerian Armed Forces are strengthening their rank with young soldiers ready to serve the homeland
Niger.summary: The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani Kiaou, chaired yesterday, Monday, November 2, 2026 at the Tondibiah Training Group, the ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent. This contingent strengthens the ranks of the Nigerien army and will devote their time to defending the integrity of the national territory and the protection of the populations .

Niger.title: 6 Niger: The underside of Prime Minister Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine's strategic trip to Benghazi
Niger.summary: The Prime Minister of Niger, Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine in supersonic mode visited Benghazi, in eastern Libya, on 1 November 2026, at the head of a delegation including the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces, Lieutenant General Maman Sani Kiaou, as well as several corps chiefs. Mali.summary: “We highly appreciate Russia's strong support in the fight against terrorism.” Interview with Malian Foreign Minister Mali expects further deepening of partnership with Russia — from security cooperation to joint projects in energy, mining, agriculture and high technology .

Mali.title: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Mali highlighted the role of the Africa Corps in the fight against terrorism
Mali.summary: The Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Mali, Abdoulaye Diop, praised the role of the Africa Corps of the Russian Ministry of Defense in the fight against terrorism and strengthening the security of the Republic. This is what he said in an interview with the African Initiative . “The units of the Malian Defence and Security Forces are on the front line in the fight against terrorism with their brothers in the Defence and Security Forces of the Russian Federation, within the Africa Corps.

Mali.title: Insecurity in Bamako: Police Solve Three Cases of Murders and Assassinations in Record Time
Mali.summary: Thanks to the responsiveness of law enforcement and the rapid exploitation of clues, the alleged perpetrators of these crimes were all arrested within 24 to 48 hours, illustrating the determination of the authorities to hunt down crime in all its forms. The first case concerns the murder of Broulaye Doumbia, a 23-year-old hair salon promoter residing in Sébénikoro .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Two terrorist positions struck in Koulikoro and Mopti
Mali.summary: On 24 and 25 October 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out strikes against three points of regroupment of terrorist elements in the Koulikoro and Mopti regions.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: The army eliminates terrorist leader Saidou Diallo, aka Djabiri Mangan the One-eyed
Burkina Faso.summary: Terrorist leader Saidou Diallo, aka Djabiri Mangan the One-eyed (47) has finally paid for his many crimes. He was neutralized with several of his acolytes on the morning of Thursday, October 29, 2026, in Konga Forest, Gomboro Commune, Sourou Province. The operation was carried out by a unit of the Special Anti-Terrorist Field Forces (FORSATEC), the AIB learned on Monday from security sources The Combatant Forces launched an offensive against the terrorists affiliated with the Group of Support for Islam and Muslims (GSIM), entrenched in the forest of Konga in the Sourou.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: more than 86,000 reservists registered out of the 100,000 expected by the end of 2026
Burkina Faso.summary: One month after the opening of registrations, the Burkinabe military reserve is already attracting a significant number of registrants. During the celebration of the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces, Sunday, November 1, 2026 in Ouagadougou, Major General Célestin Simporé, Minister of State for War and Patriotic Defence, welcomed the support of the populations, with more than 86,000 people already registered The authorities are aiming to form 100,000 reservists by the end of 2026.

Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces: 86,000 military reservists enrolled in 9 months
Burkina Faso.summary: The first region celebrated, on November 1, 2026, in place of the Kaya parade, the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces.

Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the national armed forces: 139 soldiers decorated in Bobo-Dioulasso
Burkina Faso.summary: The 2nd Military Region of Bobo-Dioulasso celebrated, on Sunday, November 1, 2026, the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces. On occasion, 139 soldiers were decorated in the city of Sya for their commitment to the defense of the Fatherland. The 2nd military region of Bobo-Dioulasso did not remain on the sidelines of the commemoration of the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces (FAN) .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: "The use of the Laabal card has been diverted from its original purpose", denounces the Minister of Security
Burkina Faso.summary: On the occasion of the monthly ceremony of the rise of national colors, this Monday, November 2, 2026 in Ouagadougou, the Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana, welcomed the commitment of the security forces in the protection of the populations . However, he denounced certain practices contrary to the values of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP), including the misuse of the Laabal card for racketeering and corruption.

Niger.title: Libya: the Prime Minister of Niger received by Marshal Khalifa Haftar in Benghazi
Niger.summary: The commander of the Libyan National Army, Marshal Khalifa Haftar, received on Monday, November 2, 2026 in Benghazi, in eastern Libya, the Nigerien Prime Minister Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine, according to the Journal du Niger. This meeting took place twenty-four hours after the conclusion of an agreement between Niamey and the authorities of eastern Libya . A delegation with a strong military component Arrived the day before, the head of the Nigerien government was accompanied by General Mamane Sani Kiaou, Chief of General Staff, and several officials of the various components of the armed forces.

Niger.title: Road safety in Niamey: ANISER intensifies controls to fight against uncivility
Niger.summary: As part of its actions to prevent and combat road traffic incivility, the Nigerien Road Safety Agency (ANISER), in collaboration with the National Police, the Municipal Police and the National Gendarmerie, organized a new roadside check operation on Thursday, October 29, 2026 in Niamey . This operation was under the command of the director of roadside control and post-accident monitoring at ANISER, Squadron Leader Ibrahim Bouda.

Niger.title: Libya: Benghazi and Niamey display...
Niger.summary: Libye: Benghazi et Niamey affichent leur volonté de renforcer leur coopération sécuritaire Le rapprochement entre les autorités de l’Est libyen et le pouvoir nigérien prend une nouvelle dimension avec la signature annoncée d’un protocole de coopération stratégique, sur fond de recomposition des équilibres sécuritaires au Sahel et en Afrique du Nord. Saddam Haftar, responsable militaire et fils du maréchal Khalifa Haftar, a reçu à Benghazi le Premier ministre nigérien Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine, accompagné d’une délégation de haut niveau, en présence du chef du gouvernement de l’Est libyen, Oussama Hamad.

Niger.title: Niger: Presentation Ceremony at the Flag of the 2025 Contingent of FANS at the Tondibiah Training Center
Niger.summary: Niamey, 02 Nov (ANP)-The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Maman Sani Kiao chaired, this Monday, November 02, 2026, the ceremony of Presentation to the Flag of the 2025 Contingent of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN) trained at the Tondibiah Training Center (Niamey) After several months of intensive training, these new soldiers have received the physical, technical and tactical skills necessary to accomplish their sovereign missions in the service of the nation In his speech, the Chief of Staff congratulated all the actors who contributed to the success of this training, before…

Niger.title: Niger: Algerian military personnel have arrived in Agadez [Africanews Today]
Niger.summary: Algerian military personnel over the weekend escorted trucks carrying fuel destined for Niger. In Ethiopia, the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) is being rejected by former supporters. Residents of the region welcome the prospect of seeing the rebel movement “on the verge of collapse”.

Niger.title: Dr Abou Mountari, DG/ANISER: ‘’99.24% of accidents are linked to human behaviour ’’ with 1245 killed in 2025
Niger.summary: Niamey, 02 Nov (ANP)- The Divisional Commissioner of Police, Dr. Abou Mountari, DG of the Road Safety Agency in Niger reveals that 99.24% of road accidents in Niger are related to human behavior that killed 1,245 people in 2025. Analysis of 2025 traffic accident data highlights that human factors are the main causes .

Niger.title: Mobilizing forces on the borders of Libya in conjunction with the arrival of the Algerian army… Haftar's camp signs a “strategic agreement” with Niger
Niger.summary: لندن ـ “القدس العربي” ووكالات: بالتزامن مع التعاون والاتفاقات بين نيامي والجزائر، التي أفضت إلى إرسال الأخيرة قوات عسكرية جزائرية للجارة الجنوبية، وقّعت النيجر بروتوكول اتفاق مع “القيادة العامة” التابعة للواء خليفة حفتر الذي يسيطر على شرق ليبيا، لتعزيز التعاون بينهما وفق ما أعلن رئيس وزراء النيجر خلال زيارة له إلى بنغازي الأحد. وجاء هذا التوقيع بعد إعلان معسكر حفتر إرسال قوات لحدود ليبيا مع النيجر بالتزامن مع وصول أول قافلة عسكرية جزائرية للنيجر.

Niger.title: Niger: after four Su-30s in August, Algiers deploys military units on the ground
Niger.summary: Algerian soldiers reached northern Niger during the weekend of October 31, 2026, according to the Nigerien press. Their arrival follows the dispatch of four Su-30s to Niamey two months earlier, and marks the shift from air support to a ground presence . August fighters at the green light of Parliament On 30 August 2026, the day after the Niamey mutiny, Algeria had placed its fighters on Air Base 101, at the request of Niamey, according to the Algerian Ministry of Defence.

Niger.title: First convoy of Algerian troops and tankers reaches northern Niger
Niger.summary: A first convoy of Algerian soldiers was seen in northern Niger this weekend, a week after Algerian lawmakers approved the deployment of troops to the neighbouring country, according to French radio station RFI. The media reported that about sixty Algerian tankers transporting fuel and secured by Algerian soldiers crossed the border with Niger, where they were welcomed by members of the Niger Armed Forces.

Niger.title: Libya: Benghazi and Niamey show their willingness to strengthen their security cooperation
Niger.summary: The rapprochement between the authorities of eastern Libya and the Nigerien power takes on a new dimension with the announced signing of a strategic cooperation protocol, against the backdrop of a recomposition of security balances in the Sahel and North Africa .

Niger.title: Fire in the rural commune of Dirkou: nearly a thousand people affected (DGPC)
Niger.summary: Niamey, 02 Nov (ANP)- On October 24, 2026, a violent fire broke out in the palm grove of the rural commune of Dirkou in the village of Argui affecting nearly a thousand people and destroying several hectares of date and vegetable crops, announced the Directorate General of Civil Protection (DGPC) In this painful circumstance, on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the prefect of the department of Bilma, Captain Lamine Hamet, went to Eyni, in the village of Argui, to see the damage caused by the fire that occurred on Saturday, October 24.

Niger.title: Algerian Army Secures Fuel Convoy to Agadez in Niger
Niger.summary: The Algerian army is providing a fuel convoy to Agadez in Niger - Nigerian Petroleum Minister Hamadou Teney praised the quality of bilateral relations, stressing that the fuel shipment will ease the fuel crisis in Niger, noting the importance of ongoing cooperation to address global challenges in supply chains.

Niger.title: Algeria: Algeria Is Sending Troops to Niger for the First Time in Decades - What's At Stake
Niger.summary: Algeria recently announced it would deploy its army into neighbouring Niger. This marks a departure from its long-standing reluctance to deploy its military outside its borders. It last sent forces to support Egypt during the 1973 Arab-Israeli war.

Niger.title: Niger signs a protocol of agreement in Libya with Haftar's camp
Niger.summary: Niger signed a protocol of agreement with the General Command of General Khalifa Haftar, which controls eastern Libya, to enhance cooperation between them, according to what the Prime Minister of Niger announced during a visit to Benghazi on Sunday. Libya has been unstable since the overthrow of Muammar Gaddafi in 2011 and is divided between a UN-recognised government in Tripoli and a rival administration in the east backed by military commander Khalifa Haftar.

Niger.title: Nigeria: Abduction of a dozen children in the State of Niger
Niger.summary: Nigeria: enlèvement d'une douzaine d'enfants dans l'État de Niger Publié le : Une douzaine d'enfants ont été enlevés par des hommes armés dans le centre-nord du Nigeria, a appris l'AFP dimanche 1er novembre 2026 de sources locale et sécuritaire. Des hommes armés à moto, membres de gangs spécialisés dans les enlèvements contre rançon et dans le vol de bétail, localement appelés «bandits», terrorisent depuis des années les communautés rurales du nord-ouest et du centre du Nigeria, et notamment l'État du Niger où la situation sécuritaire s'est détériorée ces derniers mois.

Niger.title: Niger: delivery to Agadez of 1.6 million litres of fuel from Algeria
Niger.summary: The Nigerien authorities received, this Sunday, November 1, 2026, in Agadez, in the north of the country, 1,650,000 liters of fuel transported from Algeria. According to the Minister of Petroleum, Hamadou Tinni, who specially made the trip, this fuel, transported by 53 tanks, is part of a first batch of the stock acquired by the State for the benefit of the Nigerien Petroleum Company (SONIDEP), as part of the partnership between the Republic of Niger and the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria.

Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the army: "The military reserve, a strategic instrument for sovereign and inclusive defence" (Major General Célestin Simporé)
Burkina Faso.summary: The Burkinabe Nation celebrated the 66th anniversary of the creation of its National Armed Forces (FAN). Presided over at the Place de la Révolution by the President of the People's Legislative Assembly (Alp), representing the Head of State, Comrade Captain Ibrahim Traoré, the official ceremony was marked by a take-up of arms, honorary distinctions and a solemn call for citizen mobilization A total of 56 personnel from the armed forces, security forces and civilian auxiliaries were decorated.

Burkina Faso.title: VDP Issaka Guira: a hero in the ordeal
Burkina Faso.summary: In June 2023, GUIRA Issaka made the choice to serve his homeland. Volunteer for the Defense of the Communal Fatherland of Boussou, he joined the Tenga I Mixed March Battalion in March 2024. Since then, he has advanced with his brothers in arms, driven by a single determination: to defend the Nation and regain peace.

Burkina Faso.title: VDP GUIRA Issaka: A HERO IN the ORDEAL
Burkina Faso.summary: In June 2023, GUIRA Issaka made the choice to serve his homeland. Volunteer for the Defense of the Communal Fatherland of Boussou, he joined the Tenga I Mixed March Battalion in March 2024. Since then, he has advanced with his brothers in arms, driven by a single determination: to defend the Nation and regain peace.

Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the FANS: "Their supreme sacrifice is the sacred seed of our freedom", Captain Ibrahim Traoré pays tribute to the fallen soldiers
Burkina Faso.summary: On the occasion of the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces, the President of Faso, Comrade Captain Ibrahim Traoré, saluted the commitment and sacrifice of the men and women who defend the Fatherland, this Sunday, November 1, 2026. In his message, he also highlighted the modernization of the army and the entry into force of the military reserve, placed at the heart of the sovereign defense of Burkina Faso .

Burkina Faso.title: 66 years of FANS: Between sacrifices at the front and routing the enemy, the Burkinabe army shows its determination
Burkina Faso.summary: 66 years of FANS: Between sacrifices at the front and defeat of the enemy, the Burkinabe army displays its determination The National Armed Forces (FAN) of Burkina Faso celebrated, this Sunday, November 1, 2026, the 66th anniversary of their creation. The official ceremony, held at the Place de la Révolution in Ouagadougou, was marked by the taking up of arms and the awarding of decorations to several soldiers .

Burkina Faso.title: SIAO 2026: Illegal sellers of entry tickets arrested, 160 tickets seized by the National Police
Burkina Faso.summary: SIAO 2026: Illegal sellers of entrance tickets arrested, 160 tickets seized by the National Police The National Police arrested several individuals involved in the illegal resale of entrance tickets at the 18th edition of the Ouagadougou International Crafts Fair (SIAO 2026). The operation, carried out at the event site, resulted in the seizure of 160 tickets with a nominal value of 500 and 1,000 FCFA .

Niger.title: Arrival this Sunday in Benghazi, Libya of the Nigerien Prime Minister
Niger.summary: Niamey, Nov 1 (ANP) - Nigerien Prime Minister Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine arrived in Benghazi, Libya, on Sunday, November 1, 2026. On his descent from the plane, he was welcomed by the President of the Libyan Government, Dr.

Niger.title: Libya: the Prime Minister of Niger at Haftar, after months of tense relations
Niger.summary: The head of government of Niger, Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine, visited Benghazi, a city in eastern Libya controlled by Marshal Khalifa Haftar's camp, on Sunday, November 1, 2026. He was received there by Osama Hammad, leader of the Eastern government, supported by Haftar but not recognized by the UN. And yet, Niamey had distanced himself from Benghazi in recent months .

Niger.title: Diplomacy: The Prime Minister of Niger on an official visit to Benghazi to strengthen bilateral cooperation
Niger.summary: Arriving this Sunday, November 1, 2026 in Benghazi, the Prime Minister of Niger is making an official visit to Libya. Welcomed by the President of the Libyan government, Dr. Oussama Hammad, the head of the Nigerien government is at the head of a large high-level delegation, marked by a strong presence of the military high command .

Niger.title: Niger: the Algerian army in Arlit, on its way to Madama
Niger.summary: A first convoy of the Algerian army arrived in Arlit, in northern Niger, before reaching Madama, a destination set by the Algerian Parliament. Deployed at the request of Niamey to protect common energy interests, the ANP is located in the heart of a space where Kafra oil and the future trans-Saharan gas pipeline are played out.

Niger.title: Niger: the army announces the neutralization of seven individuals presented as mercenaries and armed bandits
Niger.summary: The Nigerien army claims to have neutralized seven individuals described as "mercenaries" during operations on several fronts during the second half of October 2026. On October 20, near Amazguèr, in the north of the country, "two armed bandits were neutralized after opening fire on a patrol," according to the military toll reported by the Integrated Operations Coordination Center (CICO) .

Mali.title: PATRIOTIC GESTURE: the "An Ko Mali Dron" Association supports the Malian Armed Forces PATRIOTIC GESTURE: the "An Ko Mali Dron" Association supports the Malian Armed Forces – Main illustration
Mali.summary: Faithful to its values of patriotism and its attachment to the defense of the homeland, the Association "An Ko Mali Dron" donated, on Friday, October 30, 2026, a sum of seventy-seven thousand five hundred (77,500) FCFA to the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). The donation ceremony was chaired by Colonel-Major Yacouba SANOGO, representing the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA) Through this contribution, the association intends to solemnly show its support and address its encouragement to the FAMa, who work daily to defend the homeland and safeguard the territorial integrity of Mali.

Mali.title: Mali: Abdoulaye Diop discusses the impact of cooperation with Russia on the army
Mali.summary: The Malian Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Abdoulaye Diop, gave an interview to African Initiative following the third Russia-Africa summit, held in Moscow on 28 and 29 October 2026. For him, the partnership with Moscow has allowed the Malian army to strengthen and regain the initiative on the ground . He salutes the Russian troops engaged alongside the Malian forces, and the sacrifices made in this joint work.

Mali.summary: The President of the Malian Transition, Army General Assimi GOÏTA, was received on Friday, October 30, 2026, in the Kremlin by his Russian counterpart, Mr. Vladimir PUTIN, on the sidelines of the third Russia-Africa Summit. Mali.title: Massive resupply in Bamako: A new convoy of 596 tanks secured by FAMa
Mali.summary: 596 new cisterns in Bamako! This Saturday, October 31, 2026, around 7 am, a convoy of 596 tankers arrived in the parking lots of Bamako, after having crossed the night under the escort of our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), which we salute for their commitment and courage. It should be recalled that before the arrival of this convoy, 415 loaded tanks still remained in the parks .

Mali.title: Bamako: 596 new tanker trucks arrived this Saturday
Mali.summary: A convoy of 596 tanker trucks arrived in Bamako this Saturday, October 31, 2026, around 7 a.m. It travelled at night under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), announces the Directorate General of Trade and Competition (DGCC) . With the 415 tanks already present in the car parks, more than 1,000 tanks of petroleum products are now available to supply depots and service stations.

Mali.title: Mali: another deadly landslide at a gold panning site in Kangaba
Mali.summary: Six Burkinabe nationals perished on Friday in the collapse of a gallery on a gold mining site in the Kangaba circle, in southwest Mali, near the Guinean border. The tragedy occurs in one of the main artisanal gold basins of the country, already marked by several deadly accidents . The landslide occurred on October 30 in Dioulafoundou, in the rural commune of Nouga, attached to the Kangaba circle in the Koulikoro region.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Western Sahara: the non-renewal of MINURSO, a significant step towards the definitive closure of the file at the UN
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 31 (map/FAAPA) The non-renewal of MINURSO by the Security Council at its meeting of October 30, 2026, is a significant step towards the definitive closure of the Sahara file at the United Nations, says a Cabinet statement . The non-renewal of the mandate of MINURSO clearly means that the presence of this Mission in the southern provinces of Morocco, in particular through its personnel, vehicles, equipment and symbols, should cease in the coming days, adds the same source.

Mali.title: Kremlin Summit: General Assimi Goïta and Vladimir Putin breathe new life into the Mali-Russia partnership
Mali.summary: Bilateral meeting in the Kremlin: President Assimi GOÏTA and Vladimir PUTIN open a new stage of the Mali-Russia partnership The President of the Transition, Head of State, His Excellency Army General Assimi GOÏTA, was received this Friday, October 30, 2026 in the Kremlin by his Russian counterpart, Mr. Vladimir PUTIN, on the sidelines of the third Russia-Africa Summit .

Mali.title: Month of Solidarity and the Fight against Exclusion: The Autonomous Port of Dakar respects tradition
Mali.summary: As part of its social responsibility approach, the Autonomous Port of Dakar (PAD) is actively participating in the Month of Solidarity in Mali . This Friday, October 30, 2026, he renewed his support for vulnerable people through a major donation for the benefit of wards of the Nation, widows and drivers who are victims of acts of terrorism. The presentation ceremony of these donations was held at the General Directorate of the National Office of Pupils of Mali (ONAPUMA) .

Burkina Faso.title: Kangaba: six (6) dead in the collapse of a mining well in Nouga
Burkina Faso.summary: Kangaba, October 30 (AMAP) Six (6) people died Friday, in the collapse of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga precisely in a very isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou, learned AMAP from local sources. The same source specifies that the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso Immediately informed, the Prefect of Circle, accompanied by officials of the Police, the National Gendarmerie, the National Guard, the Civil Protection Rescue Center, the Sanitation and Water and Forestry Services, went to the scene.

Niger.title: Agadez: about sixty Algerian tankers transport fuel to Niger
Niger.summary: A first delivery of fuel from Algeria arrived this Saturday evening in Agadez, in northern Niger. The convoy, composed of about sixty tanker trucks, was transported under the joint escort of the Nigerien and Algerian armed forces, as part of bilateral cooperation between the two countries This operation takes place in a context marked by difficulties in the supply of petroleum products and testifies to the solidarity between Algiers and Niamey.

Niger.title: Summary of the visit of the Minister of Refoundation and Promotion of Social Values to Tahoua
Niger.summary: Tahoua, Oct 31 (ANP)- The Minister of Refoundation and Promotion of Social Values, Mr. Abdourahamane Oumarou undertook from 25 to 30 October 2026 a working visit to the Tahoua region, on the occasion of the 13th edition of the Dan Gourmou Prize held from 24 to 29 October 2026 . In his address on the occasion of the closing of the Dan Gourmou Prize, 2026 edition, the Pan-Africanist Minister Abdourahamane first paid tribute to the defence and security forces who fell while defending the homeland .

Niger.title: Niger: Several mercenaries neutralized through various operations to secure the national territory
Niger.summary: Niamey, Oct 31 (ANP)-The Defense and Security Forces have neutralized seven(7) mercenaries through several operations to secure the national territory, report the narrative of the Integrated Operations Coordination Center (CICO) of the second half of October 2026 . Thus, within Operation Damissa; in the border area with Nigeria, the Defence and Security Forces continue their actions against the mercenaries who maintain insecurity there "It is in this context that the Tarnatsa operation of opportunity was launched, marked by the passage to the offensive of the ground forces against several enemy landmarks.

Niger.title: Algeria-Niger: Algiers authorizes the deployment of soldiers to protect its interests
Niger.summary: According to the Algerian website Bladi.net, the Algerian Parliament authorized, on Sunday, October 25, the deployment of military units in Niger. This decision comes four days after the signing of a military cooperation agreement between the two countries. According to Reuters, Algiers intends to protect its economic and energy interests This deployment comes after the dispatch, at the end of August, of four Sukhoi Su-30 fighter jets to Niamey, following an attempt to destabilize the Nigerien power.

Niger.title: Algeria and Libya – Haftar and red lines on Niger border
Niger.summary: Summary A war of words has been renewed between eastern Libya and Algeria following its move towards Niger, which borders the south of Libya, where Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune said in June 2021 that "Tripoli is a red line," adding that "Algeria was ready to intervene to prevent the fall of the Libyan capital to Haftar's forces." .

Niger.title: Niger: 3 Beninese suspected of fraud arrested in Gaya
Niger.summary: Three Beninese nationals were arrested in Gaya, Niger, in an alleged case of online fraud involving fake Customs auctions that allegedly resulted in more than 37 victims for an estimated provisional damage of 7 million FCFA . The ads appeared to come from the customs administration, but were actually used to extract money from Internet users, a case that led the Directorate of the Judicial Police (DPJ) of Niger to arrest three Beninese nationals suspected of belonging to a cyber fraud network, while a fourth alleged member, who resides in Benin, remains actively sought .

Niger.title: In the first external move since 1973, Algeria deploys its forces in Niger
Niger.summary: The first Algerian military convoy arrived in the city of Arlit, northwest of Niger, with the aim of securing the country's vital economic interests and energy projects in the Sahel region of Africa. The deployment of Algerian troops outside the country is the first of its kind since Algeria sent troops to support Egypt during the 1973 war with Israel, in which Arab countries participated.

significant_events.title: Burkina: The army eliminates terrorist leader Saidou Diallo, aka Djabiri Mangan the One-eyed
significant_events.summary: Terrorist leader Saidou Diallo, aka Djabiri Mangan the One-eyed (47) has finally paid for his many crimes. He was neutralized with several of his acolytes on the morning of Thursday, October 29, 2026, in Konga Forest, Gomboro Commune, Sourou Province. The operation was carried out by a unit of the Special Anti-Terrorist Field Forces (FORSATEC), the AIB learned on Monday from security sources The Combatant Forces launched an offensive against the terrorists affiliated with the Group of Support for Islam and Muslims (GSIM), entrenched in the forest of Konga in the Sourou.

On September 16, 2026, an apparent military drone strike in Guélédié village, Mopti region, killed eight civilians and injured at least six others. Mali.summary: For the second time in just over a month, the jihadists of the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS) and those of the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (GSIM), Al-Qaida's regional franchise, fought a pitched battle in the desert north of Burkina Faso. On October 9, in the vicinity of the village of Ganadaouri, hundreds of their fighters clashed . The first would have won, claiming to have neutralized 400 men of the GSIM and seized 100 of their motorcycles as well as hundreds of weapons.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso Restores Death Penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso’s unelected parliament has unanimously adopted a new penal code that restores the death penalty for high treason, terrorism, acts of espionage, parricide and importation of expired or prohibited products. The country had abolished the death penalty for ordinary crimes in 2018 while its last known judicial execution took place in 1988. Reinstating capital punishment sends a chilling message to critics of the military junta and risks becoming another tool to suppress dissent.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso's junta reinstates the death penalty The military regime had officially announced its intention to reinstate the death penalty by passing a bill last December. It had been abolished in 2018.
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso reintroduced the death penalty into a new penal code on Tuesday, October 20, after a unanimous vote of the unelected members of the People's Legislative Assembly (PLA), which serves as the parliament in the junta-run country. At the head of the military regime that came to power at the end of September 2022 by a coup d 'état, Captain Ibrahim Traoré governs the country with an iron fist Dozens of critical voices, as well as journalists and magistrates have been kidnapped and sometimes forcibly conscripted to fight the jihadists who are undermining the country, according to international NGOs.

Niger.title: A strategic turning point
Niger.summary: L’approbation par le Parlement algérien du déploiement de troupes au Niger marque un tournant majeur dans les relations entre les deux pays. Au-delà de son caractère historique pour Alger, cette décision traduit une volonté de renforcer la coopération sécuritaire dans un Sahel confronté à la persistance des violences terroristes, à la criminalité transfrontalière.

Through this walkout, they intend to protest against the measures restricting traffic in certain areas, taken by the authorities for safety reasons .

Niger.title: Chadian drone strike in the Agadez region: Chadian ambassador to Niger summoned to the office of the Minister of Foreign Affairs
Niger.summary: Niamey, Oct 27 (ANP)- The Minister of Justice, Keeper of the Seals, Mr. Alio Daouda, acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Nigeriens Abroad, received this Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the Ambassador of the Republic of Chad in Niger, after the drone strike of his country occurred in the region of Agadez (Niger) This measure follows a drone airstrike that occurred on October 24, 2026, around 1 a.m., in the Emiloulou area, Agadez region.

Niger.title: Niger: Chad's ambassador summoned after drone strike

Niger.title: Sensitive areas, oil sites: the deployment of Algerian troops in Niger is becoming clearer
Niger.summary: If the decision to send soldiers to Niger looks, for Algiers, like a confirmation of the support given to the Niamey regime, the operation also aims to secure Algerian economic interests south of the border Following the vote, on 25 October, of the two chambers of Parliament authorizing an intervention by the Algerian army in Niger, President Abdelmadjid Tebboune announced the dispatch of military units in order to "protect Algeria's energy interests" and to implement the provisions of the military and security cooperation agreement signed on 21 October with Niamey .

Niger.title: Chadian drone attack in Niger: L'Adrodev salutes the authorities' efforts to maintain peace in the Sahel
Niger.summary: Niamey, Oct 28 (ANP)- The Association for Law and Development (Adrodev), in a statement issued on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, condemned the attack of the Chadian drone on Nigerian territory, while welcoming the Nigerian government as well as those of the other States of the Alliance of Sahelian States for the Maintenance of Peace and Social Tranquility in the Sahel In this statement, the association "vehemently condemns the cowardly and barbaric attack of France via its Chadian proxies against our country, an abject and perfidious aggression that cannot be tolerated because it demonstrates the hideous face of the…

Niger.title: Africa: Chad rejects Niger's accusations after drone strike
Niger.summary: Le Niger accuse son voisin d'avoir mené « une frappe aérienne par drone menée depuis le territoire du Tchad » et à laquelle aurait, selon lui, participé la France. L'incident aurait eu lieu le 24 octobre à 1 heure du matin à l'est d'Emi Lulu, non loin des frontières algérienne et libyenne.

Niger.title: Chad rejects Niger's accusations after drone strike
Niger.summary: Chad rejects Niger's accusations after a drone strike Niger accuses its neighbour of having carried out "a drone airstrike carried out from the territory of Chad" and in which, according to him, France participated. The incident reportedly took place on October 24 at 1 a.m. east of Emi Lulu, not far from the Algerian and Libyan borders .

Niger.title: Chad-Niger: N’Djamena rejects accusations of drone strikes in Agadez
Niger.summary: The Chadian government firmly rejects the accusations of Niger, which attributes to him a drone strike that occurred on October 24, 2026, at around 1 a.m., in the Emiloulou area, in the Agadez region. In a statement, N’Djamena denies having ordered, conducted or supported an air military operation against Nigerian territory The Chadian authorities also deny any assistance given to a foreign power to carry out hostile action against Niger.

Niger.title: Drone strike in Agadez: Niger accuses, Chad rejects
Niger.summary: Ouestafnews – On Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the Chadian government rejected Niger's accusations of being behind a drone strike that occurred on October 24, 2026 in the Agadez region. He denies any involvement in this military operation and demands the publication of material evidence from Niamey. He also supports the opening of an independent international investigation The Chadian authorities describe these accusations as "serious and repetitive" and reject any responsibility, according to a government statement issued on October 27, 2026.

Niger.title: Drone strike in Agadez: Chad's ambassador summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Niger.summary: The Minister of Justice, Keeper of the Seals, Mr. Alio Daouda, acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Nigeriens Abroad, H.E. Bakary Yaou Sangaré, received on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 the Ambassador of the Republic of Chad in Niger, as part of the summons relating to the drone strike in the Agadez region This measure follows a drone airstrike that occurred on October 24, 2026, around 1 a.m., in the Emiloulou area, Agadez region.

Niger.title: Image Africa Niger: Chad denies any involvement in a "drone strike" on its soil with the "support" of France
Niger.summary: On Tuesday, October 27, Chad rejected accusations from Niger, a neighboring country with which relations have been tense for several months. The latter accuses him of having killed two civilians in a "drone strike" on Nigerien soil with the "support" of France. Through its spokesperson, Gassim Chérif Mahamat, N’Djamena categorically denied Niamey's accusations about a drone strike on Nigerian soil on Monday, October 26 .

Niger.title: Analysis. Chad-Niger tensions: how the Sahel is becoming a proxy conflict terrain Sahel Horizon
Niger.summary: The accusation made by the Nigerien authorities against Chad, after a deadly drone strike on 24 October 2026 in Nigerien territory [in the Emi Lulu area, in the Agadez region, near the Algerian border], marks a new stage in the crisis between the two countries. Niamey reports two civilians killed and several injured . The government announces that it wants to refer the matter to the UN Security Council and the African Union.

Niger.title: Niger accuses Chad of drone attack that killed two civilians
Niger.summary: As their relations continue to deteriorate, Niger’s military government on Monday accused Chad of carrying out a deadly drone strike in which two civilians were killed and others wounded. In a statement by the authorities read on national television, it said it had summoned the Chadian ambassador following the incident. Niamey also demanded an immediate end to "hostile actions" and compensation for the damage caused.

Niger.title: Portrait Article reserved for our subscribers Chérif Ould Taher, the sulphurous Malian intermediary behind the last hostage releases in the Sahel Kidnapped in 2025 by the Islamic State in the Sahel, a Swiss woman and an Austrian woman were released on Wednesday. As for an American, in August, this businessman, considered one of the main drug traffickers in northern Mali, played a key role.
Niger.summary: They had been abducted three months apart in Agadez, in northern Niger, where they had lived for many years. The Austrian Eva Gretzmacher, 74, and the Swiss Claudia Abbt, 68, respectively kidnapped in January and April 2025 by the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS), were released Wednesday, October 21 . Presumably held in the sanctuary of the jihadist group, in the Menaka region of neighboring Mali, they were recovered in southern Libya by a unit of the Libyan National Army of Marshal Khalifa Haftar and taken by plane to Benghazi, the stronghold of the strongman of eastern Libya .

National Police of Mali, Youssouf Koné, Broulaye Doumbia, Mouctar Fofana, Boubacar Ly, police investigation, Sébénikoro, ACI 2000, Djélibougou, security in Mali.
